title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
title_zh: 多模态具身智能体：从计算机使用到机器人使用的统一能力视角

paragraphs.en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce P A P A V , a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: P erceive the current state, A nticipate action effects, P lan a feasible course, A ct through an interface or body, and V erify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体（MMAs）通过推理、记忆、工具与反馈来维持交互，最典型的形式是计算机使用智能体，而机器人系统（RSs）则在物理动力学下将感知与执行耦合在一起。 我们将多模态具身智能体（MMEAs）定义为目标导向的系统，它将多模态任务推理与物理行动相耦合，并根据由此产生的反馈修正决策。 这就引出了一个核心问题：当多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，会发生什么变化？ 我们提出 PAPAV，这是一个以能力为中心、包含五种反复出现功能的统一框架：P erceive（感知当前状态）、A nticipate（预判行动效果）、P lan（规划可行路线）、A ct（通过接口或身体行动）以及 V erify（核验结果）。 由于按功能而非架构定义，这些能力使 PAPAV 能够识别三者共同之处，进而将 MMEAs 与 MMAs 以及 RSs 进行比较。 五种物理约束——从部分可观测性到不可验证的结果——使得预先确定的选项更少，纠正错误的空间也更小。 在 64 个基准测试中，显式评估集中在 Act 上；只有 5 个评估 Anticipate，3 个评估 Verify，二者基本上都隐藏在任务成功背后。 这些约束也为我们识别的开放性挑战提供了框架。 因此，PAPAV 为设计可靠的物理智能体以及衡量所有五种能力（而非仅仅任务成功）的进展提供了共同基础。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) have grown from one-shot generation into systems that interact over time, use external tools, and revise decisions from feedback, and they now operate browsers, desktops, and phones as computer-use agents [ 217 , 213 , 168 , 171 , 186 , 239 , 198 ] . Robotic systems (RSs) have followed a complementary path: foundation models and generalist policies increasingly connect language and perception to physical action across a widening range of tasks [ 4 , 79 , 108 , 37 , 14 , 13 , 88 , 150 , 149 , 12 ] . Robotics offers a mature account of how to close the loop under physical dynamics [ 69 , 91 , 46 , 41 , 92 , 17 , 50 ] , while agent research offers ways to sustain the loop through longer interactions [ 217 , 171 , 186 , 98 , 29 , 67 , 28 , 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体（MMAs）已经从一次性生成发展为能够随时间交互、使用外部工具并根据反馈修正决策的系统，如今它们作为计算机使用智能体操作浏览器、桌面和手机 [ 217 , 213 , 168 , 171 , 186 , 239 , 198 ] 。 机器人系统（RSs）则走过了一条互补的路径：基础模型和通用策略日益将语言与感知连接到物理动作，覆盖的任务范围不断扩大 [ 4 , 79 , 108 , 37 , 14 , 13 , 88 , 150 , 149 , 12 ] 。 机器人学为如何在物理动力学下闭合回路提供了成熟的论述 [ 69 , 91 , 46 , 41 , 92 , 17 , 50 ] ，而智能体研究则提供了通过更长时间交互来维持回路的方法 [ 217 , 171 , 186 , 98 , 29 , 67 , 28 , 31 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We use multimodal embodied agent (MMEA) for a goal-directed system that uses multimodal evidence to guide physical action and feedback from that action to revise later decisions. Bringing the two traditions together changes more than the action interface. Computer-use agents can draw on structured state and direct feedback supplied by software, while conventional robotic systems can rely on constraints chosen for a known operating setting [ 239 , 198 , 216 , 17 , 50 ] . Open-ended physical interaction offers neither in full: the same loop becomes less predictable and less forgiving, and more decisions move into the interaction itself. This motivates our central question: What changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use?
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用多模态具身智能体（MMEA）来指代一种目标导向的系统，它利用多模态证据来引导物理动作，并利用该动作的反馈来修正后续决策。 将这两种传统结合起来，改变的不只是动作接口。 计算机使用智能体可以借助软件提供的结构化状态和直接反馈，而传统机器人系统则可以依赖为已知运行环境所选择的约束条件 [ 239 , 198 , 216 , 17 , 50 ] 。 开放式的物理交互却无法完全提供这两者：同样的循环变得更不可预测、更不容出错，而且更多决策转移到了交互本身之中。 这引出了我们的核心问题：当多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，会发生什么变化？

paragraphs.en: Survey taxonomies still tend to follow the field in which they were developed. Surveys of computer-use agents foreground computational architectures and digital interaction [ 40 , 197 , 181 , 215 , 16 ] , whereas surveys of embodied AI, VLA models, and robot autonomy emphasize physical tasks and execution [ 120 , 133 , 164 , 185 ] . Several recent accounts cover both computer-use and robot-use [ 40 , 120 , 164 , 215 , 16 , 143 ] , but covering both is different from drawing the analogy between them (Table 1 ): existing categories describe systems within each setting and do not show how the same function changes when its actions acquire physical consequences. The need for such an analogy is growing. Foundation models, world models, and broader robot datasets now connect capabilities that were once developed separately [ 37 , 13 , 15 , 64 , 209 , 150 , 97 ] , yet strong components do not by themselves form a coherent physical agent. Coherence depends on coordination across the full loop as the environment changes, which calls for a unit of comparison that remains stable across both settings. Figure 2 traces the two research paths and their recent convergence.
paragraphs.zh: 综述分类法仍然倾向于遵循其所在学科领域的框架。 关于计算机使用智能体（computer-use agents）的综述侧重计算架构与数字交互 [ 40 , 197 , 181 , 215 , 16 ] ，而关于具身 AI、VLA 模型与机器人自主性的综述则强调物理任务与执行 [ 120 , 133 , 164 , 185 ] 。 近期的若干综述同时涵盖了计算机使用与机器人使用 [ 40 , 120 , 164 , 215 , 16 , 143 ] ，但两者兼谈并不等于在二者之间建立类比（表 1 ）：现有分类描述的是各自场景内的系统，并未说明当同一功能的行为获得物理后果时，该功能会如何变化。 对这种类比的需求正在增长。 基础模型、世界模型以及更大规模的机器人数据集如今将原本各自独立发展的能力连接起来 [ 37 , 13 , 15 , 64 , 209 , 150 , 97 ] ，然而强大的组件本身并不能构成一个连贯的物理智能体。 连贯性依赖于环境变化时整个闭环的协调，这就需要一个在两种场景中都保持稳定的比较单元。 图 2 勾勒了这两条研究路径及其近期的汇合。

paragraphs.en: We introduce P A P A V , a unified capability-centric perspective built around five functions in a recurring task loop , the cycle through which an agent advances a task one step at a time. P erceive establishes the current state; A nticipate estimates the effects of candidate actions; P lan selects a feasible course; A ct realizes that course through an interface or body; and V erify judges the outcome and whether further interaction is needed. Each function is defined by what it contributes to the loop rather than by the component that implements it: one model may support several functions, and one function may be distributed across several models or tools. A click, a skill call, and a robot trajectory differ in form, but PAPAV asks what each contributes to the same task loop rather than whether the systems share an architecture or action space. PAPAV also sharpens two boundaries often folded into a standard observation–decision–action loop: Anticipate asks what a candidate action may cause before Plan chooses a course, and Verify asks whether post-action evidence supports the intended outcome rather than merely recording another observation. These distinctions make prediction and outcome judgment visible as separate functions while remaining compatible with existing agent and control-loop taxonomies [ 215 , 120 , 164 , 143 , 185 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 P A P A V，这是一种以能力为中心的统一视角，它围绕一个周期性任务循环中的五项功能构建——该循环即智能体将任务一步步向前推进的过程。 P erceive（感知）确立当前状态；A nticipate（预判）估计候选动作的影响；P lan（规划）选择一条可行的行动路线；A ct（行动）通过接口或身体实现该路线；V erify（验证）判断行动结果以及是否需要进一步的交互。 每项功能都由它对循环的贡献来定义，而不是由实现它的组件来定义：一个模型可以支持多项功能，一项功能也可以分布在多个模型或工具上。 一次点击、一次技能调用和一条机器人轨迹在形式上各不相同，但 PAPAV 关注的是它们各自对同一任务循环的贡献，而不是这些系统是否共享某种架构或动作空间。 PAPAV 还厘清了常被并入标准「观察–决策–行动」循环中的两个边界：预判在规划选择行动路线之前询问一个候选动作可能造成什么影响，而验证则询问行动后的证据是否支持预期结果，而不只是记录又一次观察。 这些区分使预测与结果评判作为相互独立的功能显现出来，同时仍与现有的智能体和控制循环分类体系兼容 [ 215 , 120 , 164 , 143 , 185 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The shared coordinate then isolates what embodiment changes. We study five constraints that recur in physical interaction: partial observability , limited simulatability , irreversibility , real-time coupling , and unverifiable outcomes . Together they make the loop less predictable and less forgiving, increasing the weight of what the agent decides during interaction rather than what the interface or system design fixes in advance. Memory and orchestration keep the five functions connected across time; we call this coordinating substrate the agentic harness rather than a sixth capability.
paragraphs.zh: 这一共享坐标系随后可分离出具身化究竟改变了什么。 我们研究了物理交互中反复出现的五大约束：部分可观测性、有限可模拟性、不可逆性、实时耦合以及结果不可验证性。 这些因素共同使该循环更难预测、容错更低，从而加重了智能体在交互过程中所做决策的分量，而非接口或系统设计预先固定内容的分量。 记忆与编排使这五项功能在时间维度上保持连贯；我们将这种协调性底层结构称为智能体运行框架，而非第六种能力。

sents.zh: 记忆与编排使这五项功能在时间维度上保持连贯；我们将这种协调性底层结构称为智能体运行框架，而非第六种能力。

paragraphs.en: Our scope spans MMAs, conventional RSs, and their intersection. We borrow computer-use and robot-use as shorthand for the two ends of this transition [ 198 , 83 ] , and use digital and physical throughout the body for the interaction settings along it. Robot-use here covers any configuration in which multimodal task reasoning acts through a robot body, by remote tool-style control or by an end-to-end policy, and is thus broader than cloud-controlled robots alone. The MMA and RS categories are system classes rather than settings, and they overlap. MMAs commonly operate through software interfaces, including games and simulated worlds [ 151 , 186 ] , whereas RSs center body-specific sensing and control, even when evaluated in simulation. We include virtual embodied work when it informs a capability, while whole-system MMEA membership follows the physical task-loop criteria in Section 2.3 . The task loop is therefore the unit of comparison: evidence for one capability does not by itself classify an entire system as an MMEA. Table 1 compares related surveys in terms of computer-use and robot-use coverage, benchmark analysis, and digital–physical analogy, highlighting PAPAV’s emphasis on a shared capability perspective across settings.

paragraphs.en: We adopt a task-level loop to compare multimodal agents (MMAs) and robotic systems (RSs). Each step contains one operation that advances the task, the evidence used to select it, and the feedback returned after it. In computer-use, this operation may be a GUI action or tool call. In robot-use, it may be a robot skill, waypoint, or trajectory command that a lower-level controller realizes over time. Working at the task level places both settings on a common time scale: a click and a control tick are not comparable, but a task step is. PAPAV describes five functional roles within this loop. It focuses on what each role contributes rather than how the system is implemented. This abstraction allows us to compare systems with different architectures and embodiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用任务级循环来比较多模态智能体（MMA）与机器人系统（RS）。 每一步包含一个推进任务的操作、用于选择该操作的依据，以及该操作执行后返回的反馈。 在计算机使用中，这一操作可以是 GUI 动作或工具调用。 在机器人使用中，这一操作可以是机器人技能、路径点，或由低层控制器在一段时间内实现的轨迹指令。 在任务层面工作使两种场景处于同一时间尺度上：一次点击和一个控制节拍无法比较，但一个任务步骤可以。 PAPAV 描述了该循环中的五种功能角色。 它关注每种角色的贡献，而非系统如何实现。 这一抽象使我们能够比较具有不同架构与实体形态的系统。

paragraphs.en: A multimodal agent is a goal-directed system that interacts with the environment through multimodal observations and external actions. Its observations may comprise language, images, structured states, and tool outputs. Its actions may involve language generation, GUI operations, API calls, or tool execution. At task step k k , the agent selects an action according to a k ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ g , h k , m k ) a_{k}\sim\pi(\cdot\mid g,h_{k},m_{k}) , where g g denotes the task goal, h k h_{k} the interaction history, and m k m_{k} the persistent memory. The action a k a_{k} queries or modifies the external environment and yields a new observation o k + 1 o_{k+1} . The resulting observation is incorporated into the interaction history or persistent memory, providing context for subsequent decisions. This process forms a closed interaction loop in which the agent can adjust its behavior based on environmental feedback [ 217 , 213 , 198 , 236 , 171 , 186 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体是一个以目标为导向的系统，通过多模态观测和外部动作与环境进行交互。 其观测可以包括语言、图像、结构化状态和工具输出。 其动作可以涉及语言生成、图形界面操作、API 调用或工具执行。 在任务步骤 k k，智能体根据 a k ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ g , h k , m k ) a_{k}\sim\pi(\cdot\mid g,h_{k},m_{k}) 选择一个动作，其中 g g 表示任务目标，h k h_{k} 表示交互历史，m k m_{k} 表示持久记忆。 动作 a k a_{k} 查询或修改外部环境，并产生新的观测 o k + 1 o_{k+1}。 所得的观测被纳入交互历史或持久记忆中，为后续决策提供上下文。 这一过程形成一个闭环交互回路，智能体可以基于环境反馈调整其行为 [ 217 , 213 , 198 , 236 , 171 , 186 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A multimodal embodied agent (MMEA) can be characterized by five PAPAV capabilities: multimodal perception, consequence anticipation, task-level planning, embodied action, and outcome verification. The system maintains task state throughout sensing and execution. Execution feedback informs subsequent decisions. These functions operate as a persistent closed loop between multimodal task processing and physical execution. Observed effects may differ from anticipated outcomes during execution. These discrepancies can prompt the agent to revise its task belief, reassess action feasibility, and adjust the remaining plan. Failure of an individual action does not necessarily imply failure of the overall task. The agent can use available evidence to assess recovery options and select an alternative action consistent with the task goal. At step k k , h k h_{k} denotes the interaction history, g g the task goal, and b k b_{k} the task-conditioned belief. The PAPAV loop can be formulated as:

paragraphs.en: Persistent embodied task loop: task-relevant state persists across successive rounds of physical execution, and selected actions can produce observable changes in the physical environment.

paragraphs.en: Task-level capability returns: each claimed PAPAV capability provides a documented output that can influence a subsequent task-level decision within the interaction loop.
paragraphs.zh: 任务级能力返回：每个声称的 PAPAV 能力都提供一个有据可查的输出，该输出可以在交互循环中影响后续的任务级决策。

paragraphs.en: Embodiment-grounded commitments: task decisions explicitly account for physical feasibility, execution timing, and control constraints imposed by the deployed body and operating environment.
paragraphs.zh: 具身性约束的承诺：任务决策明确考虑所部署的物理载体与运行环境所带来的物理可行性、执行时序与控制约束。

paragraphs.en: Equation ( 1 ) defines five task-level roles by their outputs and uses. Perceive forms a task belief from multimodal evidence. Anticipate estimates the state changes caused by candidate interventions, and need only estimate decision-relevant consequences [ 191 ] . Plan selects and organizes actions under task, environmental, and embodiment constraints. Act grounds the selected plan into an executable intervention and reports its progress. Verify converts post-action evidence into a verdict for continuation, termination, retry, or replanning, and must inform subsequent task decisions [ 79 , 38 ] . The roles may recur at different temporal resolutions, be combined or distributed across components, and jointly feed a single decision; throughout, we distinguish them by function and information flow.
paragraphs.zh: 式 (1) 根据输出和用途定义了五个任务级角色。 Perceive（感知）从多模态证据中形成任务信念。 Anticipate（预判）估计候选干预所引起的状态变化，且只需估计与决策相关的后果 [191]。 Plan（规划）在任务、环境和具身约束下选择并组织动作。 Act（行动）将选定的规划落地为可执行的干预并报告其进展。 Verify（验证）将动作后的证据转化为继续、终止、重试或重新规划的判定，并且必须为后续的任务决策提供信息 [79, 38]。 这些角色可以以不同的时间分辨率反复出现，可以被合并或分布到不同组件中，并共同为一个决策提供输入；在全文中，我们按功能和信息流来区分它们。

paragraphs.en: We use P A P A V as a unified capability framework to compare multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs), multimodal agents (MMAs), and robotic systems (RSs). Each capability is a recurring input–output relation within the task loop, defined by its role rather than by a module or a fixed execution order. This lets PAPAV trace the transition from computer-use to robot-use while preserving differences in implementation, embodiment, and environmental constraints. MMEAs lie at the intersection: physical embodiment constrains agent capabilities, while multimodal reasoning, goal-directed autonomy, and adaptive interaction extend the scope of conventional robotic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用PAPAV作为统一的能力框架来比较多模态具身智能体（MMEAs）、多模态智能体（MMAs）和机器人系统（RSs）。 每项能力都是任务循环内反复出现的输入–输出关系，由其角色而非某个模块或固定执行顺序来定义。 这使PAPAV能够追踪从计算机使用到机器人使用的转变，同时保留实现方式、具身形态和环境约束方面的差异。 MMEAs正处于两者的交汇点：物理具身约束了智能体能力，而多模态推理、目标导向的自主性和自适应交互则拓展了传统机器人系统的范围。

paragraphs.en: Perception maps heterogeneous, partial observations and interaction history to an action-relevant belief about the environment, task, and agent. Across MMAs and RSs, state grounding and estimation exposes entities, relations, affordances, and uncertainties needed for the current objective and subsequent action. Under partial observability, an MMEA must maintain and revise this belief across interactions. Object-centric memories and agent-editable scene graphs retain state beyond the current view, while active-perception policies select observations [ 56 , 5 , 124 ] . The agent preserves identity across viewpoints, answers open-vocabulary queries, records uncertainty and provenance, and revises outdated entries. Embodiment thus changes the responsibility, timing, and evidence for belief maintenance, while Verify separately tests whether goal-specific evidence supports a particular outcome judgment. Figure 5 compares evidence acquisition and the origin of sensing objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 感知将异构的、部分的观测与交互历史映射为与环境、任务和智能体相关的、与动作相关联的信念。 在多模态智能体与机器人系统中，状态接地与估计暴露出当前目标和后续动作所需的实体、关系、可供性与不确定性。 在部分可观测条件下，多模态具身智能体必须在交互过程中持续维护并修正这一信念。 以对象为中心的记忆和智能体可编辑的场景图能够在当前视野之外保留状态，而主动感知策略则负责选择观测 [ 56 , 5 , 124 ] 。 该智能体能够跨视角保持对象同一性、回答开放词汇查询、记录不确定性与来源信息，并修正过时的条目。 因此，具身改变了信念维护的责任、时机与证据来源，而验证环节则单独检验目标特定的证据是否支持某一结果判断。 图 5 对比了证据获取方式与感知目标的来源。

paragraphs.en: Each modality reveals different state variables and fails in different ways. Images contribute appearance and spatial cues; audio and video reveal events and temporal change; depth, proprioception, force, and touch expose geometry, embodiment, and contact. Multimodal agents fuse image regions, text, audio, video, interface state, and tool returns, while robots combine RGB, depth, proprioception, force, touch, and geometric cues. The task may also require temporal or spatial alignment, reconciliation of inconsistent signals, and retrieval of historical context [ 213 , 168 , 125 , 101 , 104 ] . MM-REACT [ 213 ] gathers image and video evidence from specialized tools; M3-Agent [ 125 ] stores visual and auditory observations in entity-centered memory; See, Hear, and Feel [ 104 ] joins global vision, acoustic events, and local tactile geometry for manipulation. The common relation is evidence integration: complementary sources recover task-relevant information that no single source supplies reliably.
paragraphs.zh: 每种模态揭示不同的状态变量，并以不同的方式失效。 图像提供外观和空间线索；音频和视频揭示事件和时间变化；深度、本体感觉、力和触觉则暴露几何结构、具身状态和接触信息。 多模态智能体融合图像区域、文本、音频、视频、界面状态和工具返回结果，而机器人则结合 RGB、深度、本体感觉、力、触觉和几何线索。 该任务还可能需要时间或空间对齐、不一致信号的调和，以及历史上下文的检索 [ 213 , 168 , 125 , 101 , 104 ] 。 MM-REACT [ 213 ] 从专用工具中收集图像和视频证据；M3-Agent [ 125 ] 将视觉和听觉观察存储在以实体为中心的记忆中；See, Hear, and Feel [ 104 ] 将全局视觉、声学事件和局部触觉几何结合起来用于操作任务。 其共同关系是证据整合：互补的信息源能够恢复任务相关信息，而任何单一信息源都无法可靠地提供这些信息。

sents.en: Each modality reveals different state variables and fails in different ways.
sents.zh: 每种模态揭示不同的状态变量，并以不同的方式失效。

sents.en: Images contribute appearance and spatial cues; audio and video reveal events and temporal change; depth, proprioception, force, and touch expose geometry, embodiment, and contact.
sents.zh: 图像提供外观和空间线索；音频和视频揭示事件和时间变化；深度、本体感觉、力和触觉则暴露几何结构、具身状态和接触信息。

sents.en: Multimodal agents fuse image regions, text, audio, video, interface state, and tool returns, while robots combine RGB, depth, proprioception, force, touch, and geometric cues.
sents.zh: 多模态智能体融合图像区域、文本、音频、视频、界面状态和工具返回结果，而机器人则结合 RGB、深度、本体感觉、力、触觉和几何线索。

sents.en: The task may also require temporal or spatial alignment, reconciliation of inconsistent signals, and retrieval of historical context [ 213 , 168 , 125 , 101 , 104 ] .
sents.zh: 该任务还可能需要时间或空间对齐、不一致信号的调和，以及历史上下文的检索 [ 213 , 168 , 125 , 101 , 104 ] 。

sents.en: MM-REACT [ 213 ] gathers image and video evidence from specialized tools; M3-Agent [ 125 ] stores visual and auditory observations in entity-centered memory; See, Hear, and Feel [ 104 ] joins global vision, acoustic events, and local tactile geometry for manipulation.

sents.en: The common relation is evidence integration: complementary sources recover task-relevant information that no single source supplies reliably.
sents.zh: 其共同关系是证据整合：互补的信息源能够恢复任务相关信息，而任何单一信息源都无法可靠地提供这些信息。

paragraphs.en: Integrated evidence remains insufficient for downstream reasoning unless it is grounded in an environment-state representation that specifies what currently exists and how it is changing. Perception must therefore associate observations with identifiable entities and events, estimate their current attributes, establish relations among them, and preserve their identities across time [ 161 , 153 , 189 , 56 , 125 ] . The resulting representation may describe objects, speakers, video events, temporal intervals, digital entities, object poses, spatial configurations, motion, contact, or robot state. Although these variables differ across environments, their representations commonly encode identity, current state, relational structure, and temporal persistence [ 154 , 180 , 182 , 163 , 82 , 56 ] . SeeClick [ 32 ] grounds language in screen coordinates; OSWorld [ 198 ] requires agents to recover application and interaction states from visual observations; and Kimera [ 163 ] converts continuous visual–inertial measurements into a dynamic scene graph containing persistent objects, agents, places, and spatiotemporal relations.
paragraphs.zh: 除非以明确说明当前存在什么以及如何变化的环境状态表示为基础，整合后的证据仍不足以支撑下游推理。 因此，感知必须将观测与可识别的实体和事件关联起来，估计它们当前的属性，建立它们之间的关系，并在时间中保持它们的身份 [ 161 , 153 , 189 , 56 , 125 ] 。 所得到的表示可以描述对象、说话人、视频事件、时间区间、数字实体、物体位姿、空间配置、运动、接触或机器人状态。 尽管这些变量在不同环境中有所不同，它们的表示通常编码身份、当前状态、关系结构和时间持久性 [ 154 , 180 , 182 , 163 , 82 , 56 ] 。 SeeClick [ 32 ] 将语言定位到屏幕坐标；OSWorld [ 198 ] 要求智能体从视觉观测中恢复应用和交互状态；Kimera [ 163 ] 将连续的视觉—惯性测量转换为包含持久对象、智能体、地点和时空关系的动态场景图。

paragraphs.en: These mechanisms define Perceive independently of any sensor suite: available evidence is integrated and grounded in a task-relevant state representation [ 213 , 104 , 56 ] . What they leave unresolved is how to seek missing evidence when current observations cannot recover the required state. Embodiment turns observation into a situated, constrained interaction [ 165 ] . The comparison must therefore track who formulates the question, who controls acquisition, and how the returned evidence affects later decisions. The two contrasts below examine digital evidence requests [ 75 ] and task-conditioned robotic active perception [ 159 , 53 ] from this task-level perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 这些机制将「感知」独立于任何传感器组合来定义：可用证据被整合并落地到与任务相关的状态表示中 [213, 104, 56]。 它们未解决的问题是：当当前观测无法恢复所需状态时，如何去寻找缺失的证据。 具身性将观测转变为一种情境化的、受约束的交互 [165]。 因此，这种比较必须追踪是谁提出问题、谁控制获取过程，以及返回的证据如何影响后续决策。 下文的两个对比从这一任务层面的视角考察数字证据请求 [75] 与任务条件下的机器人主动感知 [159, 53]。

sents.en: The two contrasts below examine digital evidence requests [ 75 ] and task-conditioned robotic active perception [ 159 , 53 ] from this task-level perspective.
sents.zh: 下文的两个对比从这一任务层面的视角考察数字证据请求 [75] 与任务条件下的机器人主动感知 [159, 53]。

paragraphs.en: Information seeking already forms part of the MMA decision loop. In AVIS [ 75 ] , tool selection follows from earlier results, returned evidence is interpreted by a reasoner, and working memory carries that evidence into subsequent search. Embodiment relocates the inquiry to the agent’s own sensorimotor relation with the environment. A pending physical commitment may expose an explicit question or an unresolved state variable, while viewpoint, contact, timing, energy, and disturbance constrain how the uncertainty can be resolved. PAPAV records the return as a qualified belief : a task-relevant proposition or state estimate accompanied by the available confidence, provenance, acquisition conditions, and freshness. The fields are analytical criteria, not properties already reported by every cited system. An update becomes task-significant when it changes the plan, the next capability invocation, or the conditions under which physical execution may proceed within the current task loop.
paragraphs.zh: 信息寻求已经构成MMA决策回路的一部分。 在AVIS [ 75 ]中，工具选择依据先前的结果，返回的证据由推理器解释，工作记忆将该证据带入后续搜索。 具身化将探究重新定位到智能体自身与环境的感知运动关系上。 待决的物理承诺可能暴露一个明确的问题或未解决的状态变量，而视角、接触、时机、能量和扰动则约束不确定性如何被解决。 PAPAV将返回结果记录为一种有条件的信念：一个与任务相关的命题或状态估计，并附带可用的置信度、来源、获取条件和新鲜度。 这些字段是分析性准则，而非每个被引用系统都已经报告的属性。 当一次更新改变计划、下一次能力调用，或在当前任务回路内物理执行得以进行的条件时，该更新即具有任务重要性。

sents.en: An update becomes task-significant when it changes the plan, the next capability invocation, or the conditions under which physical execution may proceed within the current task loop.
sents.zh: 当一次更新改变计划、下一次能力调用，或在当前任务回路内物理执行得以进行的条件时，该更新即具有任务重要性。

paragraphs.en: Robotic active perception ranges from general acquisition policies to task-conditioned perception; task relevance alone does not distinguish an MMEA. APPLE [ 165 ] learns policies across several active-perception problems, while task-oriented perception and planning [ 53 ] update beliefs over task propositions and adapt the associated plan. Explore until Confident [ 159 ] provides task-integrated embodied evidence: it receives an embodied question, builds a semantic map, selects exploratory motion, and uses calibrated confidence to decide when enough evidence has been collected. The relevant distinction is functional. A persistent task process must issue or revise the information need and later use the qualified return when choosing a capability or physical commitment. A sensing specialist may still control camera poses, tactile trajectories, stopping, and acquisition cost. The trace supports the Perceive relation, whereas whole-system membership requires separate evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人主动感知涵盖从通用的采集策略到任务条件化的感知；仅凭任务相关性并不足以区分一个 MMEA。 APPLE [ 165 ] 在多个主动感知问题上学习策略，而面向任务的感知与规划 [ 53 ] 则对任务命题的信念进行更新，并相应调整相关计划。 Explore until Confident [ 159 ] 提供了任务一体化的具身证据：它接收一个具身问题，构建语义地图，选择探索性运动，并利用校准后的置信度来决定何时已收集到足够的证据。 相关的区别在于功能层面。 一个持续运行的任务过程必须提出或修订信息需求，并在选择某项能力或物理承诺时使用经过确认的返回结果。 感知专家智能体仍可控制相机位姿、触觉轨迹、停止时机以及采集成本。 该轨迹支持 Perceive 关系，而整个系统的成员资格则需要单独的证据。

paragraphs.en: Perceive closes a task-level information gap with a belief revision that can alter a later decision. Capability coding should trace four links: the information need, embodied acquisition, qualified return, and consuming task decision. These links are observability requirements for analysis, not a common interface attributed to existing systems. Suitable traces can measure calibration, freshness, acquisition cost, and evidence-induced decision changes. Value of information is different because it asks what would have happened without the acquired evidence; estimating it requires paired trials, branching replay, or a validated simulator. An active-perception module may therefore belong to either the robotics or embodied-agent evidence lineage. Whether it is task-integrated depends on the route through which the resulting belief reaches and changes the ongoing task process.
paragraphs.zh: 感知通过一次可能改变后续决策的信念修正，弥合了任务层面的信息缺口。 能力编码应追踪四个环节：信息需求、具身获取、合格回传，以及消费该信息的任务决策。 这些环节是用于分析的可观测性要求，而不是现有系统所共有的一种通用接口。 合适的追踪记录可以测量校准度、新鲜度、获取成本，以及由证据引发的决策变化。 信息价值则不同，因为它问的是：如果没有获取该证据，本来会发生什么；估计它需要成对试验、分支重放，或经过验证的模拟器。 因此，一个主动感知模块可能属于机器人学或具身智能体这两条证据脉络之一。 它是否属于任务一体化，取决于所得信念通过何种路径到达并改变正在进行的任务过程。

paragraphs.en: Anticipation estimates consequences of a candidate action before commitment. Given belief b t b_{t} and action a t a_{t} , action-conditioned prospective modeling predicts future states, observations, rewards, risks, or task progress. It answers the counterfactual “what follows from this action?”, distinguishing action consequences from unconditional forecasts. Under embodiment, limited simulatability leaves an MMEA without a complete, authoritative simulator for open-ended physical interaction. Predictions span pixels, multi-view video, latent tokens, object state, contact, force, and task progress [ 242 , 110 , 177 , 230 , 222 , 93 ] . A useful forecast must distinguish candidate actions and inform planning or execution; visual plausibility alone cannot establish embodied realizability for the commanded action [ 210 ] . Figure 6 compares how forecasts are qualified and task-relevant counterfactuals selected.
paragraphs.zh: 预期（Anticipation）在行动承诺之前估计候选动作的后果。 给定信念 b t b_{t} 和动作 a t a_{t}，动作条件的前瞻建模预测未来状态、观测、奖励、风险或任务进展。 它回答反事实问题「这个动作会带来什么？」，从而区分动作后果与无条件预测。 在具身情境下，可仿真能力有限，使得 MMEA 没有一个完整、权威的模拟器来应对开放式的物理交互。 预测涵盖像素、多视角视频、潜在 token、物体状态、接触、力以及任务进展 [ 242 , 110 , 177 , 230 , 222 , 93 ] 。 有用的预测必须能够区分候选动作并为规划或执行提供信息；仅有视觉上的合理性无法确立所指令动作的具身可实现性 [ 210 ] 。 图 6 比较了预测如何被限定条件，以及任务相关的反事实如何被选择。

paragraphs.en: Digital and physical environments instantiate this function at different levels of abstraction. For multimodal agents, a candidate action may invoke a text-to-image model, predict a post-action webpage state, synthesize speech or music, generate a video, or call a software tool [ 57 , 19 , 42 ] ; for robotic systems, it may change future poses, velocities, contacts, collisions, object motions, rewards, and termination conditions [ 46 , 41 , 92 , 191 ] . Nevertheless, both types of systems require a prospective account of how their available actions may change a heterogeneous multimodal environment.
paragraphs.zh: 数字环境与物理环境在不同抽象层次上实例化这一功能。 对于多模态智能体，候选动作可能调用文本到图像模型、预测动作执行后的网页状态、合成语音或音乐、生成视频，或调用软件工具 [ 57 , 19 , 42 ]；对于机器人系统，它可能改变未来的位姿、速度、接触、碰撞、物体运动、奖励和终止条件 [ 46 , 41 , 92 , 191 ]。 尽管如此，两类系统都需要一种前瞻性的解释，说明其可用动作可能如何改变异构的多模态环境。

paragraphs.en: Anticipate provides Plan with information that cannot be obtained from the current environment state alone by modeling how the environment may change over time, across different contexts, or in response to possible external interventions. Starting from the environment state representation constructed by Perceive, both multimodal agents and robotic systems use predictive models to form probabilistic or structured expectations over possible future states. These models may take the form of learned transition models, generative observation models, latent dynamics, structured predictors, analytic or hybrid simulators, and tool or environment emulators [ 15 , 112 , 195 , 57 , 64 , 191 , 209 ] . In multimodal agents, predictive models can capture possible changes in language-described environments, video states, webpages, GUI applications, and other interactive digital environments [ 57 , 42 , 18 ] . In robotic systems, they can predict how control inputs may change future visual observations, object configurations, robot states, and task outcomes [ 41 , 92 , 74 ] . A world model is a general form of predictive model that represents reusable environment dynamics. Compared with a conventional predictor designed to estimate a fixed target for a specific task, a world model can recursively project multiple future steps and condition those projections on different contexts or hypothetical interventions, thereby supporting a wider range of prospective queries [ 62 , 166 , 112 , 195 ] . Its advantage therefore lies in the generality and reusability of its dynamics representation, rather than in guaranteed predictive accuracy. Similarly, a generative model functions as a world model only when its output is treated as a possible successor state for reasoning, rather than being directly committed to the environment. The output of Anticipate is thus a predictive prior or a set of plausible future states; ranking candidate actions on the basis of those futures belongs to Plan.
paragraphs.zh: Anticipate（预期）通过建模环境如何随时间变化、在不同情境下变化，或如何响应可能的外部干预，为 Plan（规划）提供仅凭当前环境状态无法获得的信息。 从 Perceive（感知）所构建的环境状态表示出发，多模态智能体和机器人系统利用预测模型，对可能的未来状态形成概率性或结构化的预期。 这些模型可以采取学习到的转移模型、生成式观测模型、潜在动力学、结构化预测器、解析或混合模拟器，以及工具或环境仿真器等形式 [ 15 , 112 , 195 , 57 , 64 , 191 , 209 ] 。 在多模态智能体中，预测模型可以捕捉语言描述的环境、视频状态、网页、GUI 应用程序及其他交互式数字环境中可能发生的变化 [ 57 , 42 , 18 ] 。 在机器人系统中，预测模型可以预测控制输入将如何改变未来的视觉观测、物体配置、机器人状态以及任务结果 [ 41 , 92 , 74 ] 。 世界模型是预测模型的一种通用形式，它表示可复用的环境动力学。 与为特定任务估计固定目标的传统预测器相比，世界模型能够递归地推演多个未来步骤，并使这些推演以不同情境或假设性干预为条件，从而支持更广泛的前瞻性查询 [ 62 , 166 , 112 , 195 ] 。 因此，其优势在于动力学表示的通用性与可复用性，而非有保证的预测精度。 类似地，生成模型只有在将其输出视为用于推理的可能后继状态、而非直接提交给环境时，才作为世界模型发挥作用。 因此，Anticipate（预期）的输出是一个预测性先验或一组合理的未来状态；基于这些未来状态对候选动作进行排序则属于 Plan（规划）。

paragraphs.en: A predictor need not expose every pixel, waveform, or sensor reading in a rollout. Passing raw images, video, or multisensory trajectories downstream can be expensive and can obscure the changes that matter to the task [ 19 , 204 , 63 , 66 , 166 , 225 ] . Semantic representations instead name expected changes in entities, events, relations, affordances, constraints, or task progress, sometimes as a delta from the current state [ 57 , 237 , 204 , 4 ] . Latent representations preserve decision-relevant dynamics without reconstructing every observation [ 62 , 166 , 74 ] . Either form may encode one future, several alternatives, or uncertainty, and hybrid representations are possible. AppDeltaWorld [ 204 ] predicts mobile-GUI transitions as delta code; MuZero [ 166 ] retains information for rewards, policies, and values in latent dynamics; and Video Prediction Policy [ 74 ] extracts predictive visual features for robot control. Across domains, Anticipate preserves the differences among possible environmental changes that matter to the next decision.
paragraphs.zh: 预测器无需在推演中暴露每一个像素、波形或传感器读数。 将原始图像、视频或多模态传感器轨迹直接向下游传递可能代价高昂，并可能掩盖对任务真正重要的变化 [ 19 , 204 , 63 , 66 , 166 , 225 ] 。 语义表示则改为对实体、事件、关系、可供性、约束或任务进展中预期发生的变化进行命名，有时以相对于当前状态的增量形式表示 [ 57 , 237 , 204 , 4 ] 。 潜在表示在不必重建每一条观测的情况下保留与决策相关的动态 [ 62 , 166 , 74 ] 。 两种形式都可以编码单一未来、多个备选方案或不确定性，并且混合表示也是可能的。 AppDeltaWorld [ 204 ] 将移动 GUI 的状态转换预测为增量代码；MuZero [ 166 ] 在潜在动态中保留用于奖励、策略和价值的信息；Video Prediction Policy [ 74 ] 则提取预测性视觉特征用于机器人控制。 跨领域来看，Anticipate 保留了各种可能的环境变化中对下一步决策重要的差异。

paragraphs.en: Predictive models and semantic or latent abstractions thus transform a grounded current state into task-relevant consequences of candidate interventions [ 204 , 63 ] . In open-ended physical interaction, plausibility alone does not make a forecast decision-worthy: simulator error, uncertain contact, and environmental change can make the same predictor useful in one regime and misleading in another [ 191 , 230 , 210 ] . Robotic prediction already spans control-internal imagination and task-aware semantic–dynamic coupling [ 191 , 224 ] . The remaining issue is whether a task-level decision selects the counterfactual and consumes its return. The next two contrasts address this question through comparisons with digital future prediction and control-centric robotic prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，预测模型以及语义或潜在抽象将当前的具体状态转化为候选干预的与任务相关的后果 [ 204 , 63 ] 。 在开放式物理交互中，仅有合理性并不足以使一个预测具有决策价值：仿真误差、不确定的接触以及环境变化，可能使同一个预测器在某种情形下有用，而在另一种情形下产生误导 [ 191 , 230 , 210 ] 。 机器人预测已经涵盖了控制内部的想象以及任务感知的语义—动力学耦合 [ 191 , 224 ] 。 剩下的问题在于，任务级决策是否会选择该反事实并消费其返回结果。 接下来的两个对比通过与数字未来预测以及以控制为中心的机器人预测进行比较来回答这一问题。

sents.en: Predictive models and semantic or latent abstractions thus transform a grounded current state into task-relevant consequences of candidate interventions [ 204 , 63 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，预测模型以及语义或潜在抽象将当前的具体状态转化为候选干预的与任务相关的后果 [ 204 , 63 ] 。

sents.en: The remaining issue is whether a task-level decision selects the counterfactual and consumes its return.
sents.zh: 剩下的问题在于，任务级决策是否会选择该反事实并消费其返回结果。

sents.en: The next two contrasts address this question through comparisons with digital future prediction and control-centric robotic prediction.
sents.zh: 接下来的两个对比通过与数字未来预测以及以控制为中心的机器人预测进行比较来回答这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Action-conditioned prediction supports candidate comparison in digital as well as embodied settings. Web Agents with World Models [ 19 ] estimates the next observation and reward for web actions and uses those estimates in policy selection; the software platform and its external services help delimit the transitions for which the model is informative, without making those transitions universally deterministic or reversible. Physical forecasts instead depend on estimated dynamics, contact, embodiment, and disturbances that remain only partly controlled at deployment. Their decision value is bounded by where and how the predictor has been evaluated. An applicability envelope should therefore report the predicted variables and horizon, the tested operating conditions, and any signal used to detect departure from those conditions. This is a reporting requirement that links a forecast to its uncertainty and known limits, not a feature attributed to every physical predictor.
paragraphs.zh: 动作条件预测支持在数字环境及具身环境中进行候选方案比较。 具有世界模型的网络智能体 [ 19 ] 为网络动作估计下一观测和奖励，并将这些估计用于策略选择；该软件平台及其外部服务有助于界定模型在其中具有信息量的转移，而不会使这些转移具有普适的确定性或可逆性。 物理预测则依赖于对动力学、接触、具身形态和扰动的估计，而这些因素在部署时仅受到部分控制。 它们的决策价值受限于预测器在何处以及如何被评估。 因此，适用范围包络应报告预测的变量和时间跨度、已测试的运行条件，以及用于检测偏离这些条件的任何信号。 这是一项将预测与其不确定性和已知局限相关联的报告要求，而不是归于每个物理预测器的特性。

paragraphs.en: Robotic world models span rather than stop at control-centric prediction. DayDreamer [ 191 ] uses imagined action outcomes to improve a control policy while learning from real interaction, whereas ModularAgent [ 224 ] already couples task semantics and latent dynamics bidirectionally. ModularAgent is therefore a boundary system, not evidence that task-aware prediction is absent from robotics. PAPAV identifies the task-integrated embodied relation through a task-level route: the current decision specifies the candidate physical intervention to be queried, and the returned consequence can change commitment among candidates before execution. A modular interface may expose that route directly; for a fused policy, a prediction trace, controlled intervention, or change in candidate ranking can provide attribution evidence. No particular module boundary or model ablation is required by the definition.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人世界模型跨越而非止步于以控制为中心的预测。 DayDreamer [ 191 ] 在从真实交互中学习的同时，利用想象的动作结果来改进控制策略，而 ModularAgent [ 224 ] 已经将任务语义与潜在动态进行双向耦合。 因此，ModularAgent 是一个边界系统，而非表明任务感知预测在机器人学中缺失的证据。 PAPAV 通过任务级路径识别任务一体化的具身关系：当前决策指定待查询的候选物理干预，而返回的结果可以在执行之前改变对候选者的承诺。 模块化接口可以直接暴露该路径；对于融合策略，预测轨迹、受控干预或候选排名的变化都可以提供归因证据。 该定义不要求任何特定的模块边界或模型消融。

paragraphs.en: Anticipate is present when a candidate physical intervention conditions a prospective consequence that reaches the task decision before commitment. Evaluation should separate errors on executed transitions and detection of out-of-envelope cases from counterfactual measures such as ranking agreement or decision regret. Executed outcomes are observable afterward; unchosen alternatives require branching simulation, replay, paired trials, or repeated physical evaluation. Representational adequacy remains task-relative. A compact state delta can outperform a visually detailed rollout for decision support when it preserves the differences that govern commitment, but this decision-sufficiency criterion does not imply greater predictive accuracy across tasks or operating regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个候选物理干预所制约的潜在后果在承诺之前到达任务决策时，Anticipate（预见）即成立。 评估应当把执行轨迹上的错误和超出包络情况的检测，与反事实度量（如排序一致性或决策遗憾）区分开来。 已执行的结果事后可观测；未被选择的备选方案则需要分支仿真、回放、配对试验或重复的物理评估。 表征的充分性始终是相对于任务而言的。 当一个紧凑的状态增量能够保留决定承诺的差异时，它在决策支持上可以胜过视觉上精细的推演，但这一决策充分性准则并不意味着在跨任务或跨运行工况下具有更高的预测准确性。

sents.en: Anticipate is present when a candidate physical intervention conditions a prospective consequence that reaches the task decision before commitment.
sents.zh: 当一个候选物理干预所制约的潜在后果在承诺之前到达任务决策时，Anticipate（预见）即成立。

sents.en: Evaluation should separate errors on executed transitions and detection of out-of-envelope cases from counterfactual measures such as ranking agreement or decision regret.
sents.zh: 评估应当把执行轨迹上的错误和超出包络情况的检测，与反事实度量（如排序一致性或决策遗憾）区分开来。

sents.en: Executed outcomes are observable afterward; unchosen alternatives require branching simulation, replay, paired trials, or repeated physical evaluation.
sents.zh: 已执行的结果事后可观测；未被选择的备选方案则需要分支仿真、回放、配对试验或重复的物理评估。

sents.en: Representational adequacy remains task-relative.
sents.zh: 表征的充分性始终是相对于任务而言的。

sents.zh: 当一个紧凑的状态增量能够保留决定承诺的差异时，它在决策支持上可以胜过视觉上精细的推演，但这一决策充分性准则并不意味着在跨任务或跨运行工况下具有更高的预测准确性。

paragraphs.en: Planning selects and organizes available or candidate actions into a goal-directed course, specifying execution order and dependencies under task constraints. Action schemas, affordances, search, and verification support this process. Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners [ 78 ] maps proposed steps to admissible actions; SayCan [ 4 ] selects skills using language scores and learned affordances; LLM-Modulo [ 94 ] refines candidate plans through verification. The resulting plan links selected actions to their prerequisites and subgoals. This organization determines which actions can proceed independently and which must wait for earlier steps to establish the required conditions. Physical irreversibility requires an MMEA’s action selection and ordering to satisfy spatial, temporal, and safety constraints [ 60 , 80 , 160 ] . As task conditions change, Plan can revise the remaining sequence or select an alternative course. Without a feasible course, planning may call for clarification, assistance, or abstention. Plan determines actions and their relations; Act provides body-specific execution. Figure 7 compares the starting state for recovery and the decision scope for selecting a revised course.
paragraphs.zh: 规划将可用或候选动作选择并组织成一条面向目标的行动路线，在任务约束下确定执行顺序与依赖关系。 动作模式、可供性、搜索与验证支持这一过程。 Language Models as Zero-Shot Planners [ 78 ] 将提议的步骤映射为可执行动作；SayCan [ 4 ] 结合语言评分与学习到的可供性来选择技能；LLM-Modulo [ 94 ] 通过验证来精炼候选计划。 所得到的计划将选定的动作与其前提条件和子目标关联起来。 这种组织方式决定了哪些动作可以独立推进，哪些动作必须等待先前步骤建立所需条件后才能进行。 物理不可逆性要求 MMEA 的动作选择与排序满足空间、时间和安全约束 [ 60 , 80 , 160 ] 。 随着任务条件的变化，Plan 可以修订剩余的动作序列或选择另一条行动路线。 在不存在可行路线时，规划可以请求澄清、寻求协助或选择弃权。 Plan 确定动作及其相互关系；Act 提供针对具体身体的执行。 图 7 对比了恢复的起始状态以及选择修订路线时的决策范围。

sents.zh: 随着任务条件的变化，Plan 可以修订剩余的动作序列或选择另一条行动路线。

paragraphs.en: Planning commonly begins from a task goal, a representation of the current state, predicted consequences, and the capabilities available in the environment [ 57 , 4 , 51 ] . Because long-horizon tasks contain complex dependencies and combinatorial choices, both multimodal agents and robotic systems decompose goals into intermediate subgoals, order their dependencies, and progressively refine them into reusable components at finer decision scales [ 1 , 91 , 157 , 105 , 155 ] . Multimodal agents can construct workflows from GUI operations, tools, APIs, or programs, whereas robotic systems can compose navigation and manipulation stages, motion primitives, and learned skills [ 155 , 117 , 170 , 108 ] . ProgPrompt [ 173 ] expresses situated task plans as programs, while Code as Policies [ 108 ] composes perception and control APIs into executable procedures. Across digital and physical environments, the shared role of abstraction is to express the task goal and environment state against a reusable vocabulary of tools, skills, or programs, while preserving the environment-specific conditions under which each capability is available.
paragraphs.zh: 规划通常始于任务目标、当前状态的表示、预测的后果以及环境中可用的能力 [ 57 , 4 , 51 ] 。 由于长程任务包含复杂的依赖关系和组合性选择，多模态智能体和机器人系统都会将目标分解为中间子目标，排序这些子目标之间的依赖关系，并在更精细的决策尺度上逐步将其细化为可复用的组件 [ 1 , 91 , 157 , 105 , 155 ] 。 多模态智能体可以基于 GUI 操作、工具、API 或程序构建工作流，而机器人系统则可以组合导航与操作阶段、运动基元以及习得的技能 [ 155 , 117 , 170 , 108 ] 。 ProgPrompt [ 173 ] 将情境化的任务计划表达为程序，而 Code as Policies [ 108 ] 则将感知与控制 API 组合为可执行的过程。 在数字环境与物理环境中，抽象的共同作用在于：以可复用的工具、技能或程序词汇来表达任务目标与环境状态，同时保留每种能力可用时所依赖的环境特定条件。

paragraphs.en: Once the problem is structured, Plan must deliberate over alternatives rather than continue once from the prompt. Candidate courses can be searched, scored under predicted outcomes, rejected on failed preconditions, and revised after new evidence. Multimodal agents compare webpage outcomes, choose tools, or assemble dependency-aware workflows [ 193 , 117 , 57 , 168 ] ; robots compare skills, symbolic sequences, grasps, and trajectories under affordance, kinematic, collision, and motion constraints [ 51 , 4 ] . WebOperator [ 36 ] ranks web actions and backtracks from unsafe paths, ControlLLM [ 123 ] searches a tool graph with parameter and dependency relations, and ReKep [ 80 ] optimizes a sequence of relational keypoint constraints for manipulation. A missing API operation and an unreachable grasp thus have the same analytical effect: either can invalidate a goal-relevant candidate. Plan returns the course that survives these checks, with its intermediate objectives, ordering, dependencies, and applicability constraints [ 168 , 123 , 70 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一旦问题被结构化，「规划」必须对备选方案进行深入推敲，而不是仅仅根据提示词一次性执行到底。 候选行动方案可以被搜索，在预测结果下评分，在前置条件失败时被否决，并在出现新证据后进行修订。 多模态智能体比较网页操作结果、选择工具或组装具备依赖感知的工作流 [ 193 , 117 , 57 , 168 ] ；机器人则可供性、运动学、碰撞和运动约束下比较技能、符号序列、抓取和轨迹 [ 51 , 4 ] 。 WebOperator [ 36 ] 对网页操作进行排序并从 unsafe 路径回溯，ControlLLM [ 123 ] 在包含参数与依赖关系的工具图上进行搜索，ReKep [ 80 ] 则针对操作任务优化一系列关系关键点约束。 因此，一个缺失的 API 操作和一个无法实现的抓取具有同样的分析效果：两者都可能使与目标相关的候选方案失效。 「规划」返回通过上述检验的行动方案，包括其中间目标、排序、依赖关系和适用性约束 [ 168 , 123 , 70 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon decomposition and feasibility-aware selection are shared across the two system classes [ 168 , 91 , 123 , 4 ] . They explain coherent selection but not recovery after execution produces a discrepant state [ 192 , 122 , 61 ] . Once a physical commitment alters the world, recoverability becomes a planning variable rather than feedback for an inexpensive retry. The contrasts below compare recovery from physical change with digital plan revision, then distinguish task-level governance of commitment from local robotic replanning during continued interaction [ 79 , 160 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 长时程分解与可行性感知选择在两类系统之间是共享的 [ 168 , 91 , 123 , 4 ] 。 它们解释了一致的选择，但无法解释当执行产生偏离状态后的恢复 [ 192 , 122 , 61 ] 。 一旦物理性承诺改变了世界，可恢复性就成为智能体规划中的一个变量，而不是可供低成本重试的反馈。 下文的对比首先比较从物理变化中恢复与数字计划修订，进而区分对承诺的任务级治理与持续交互过程中的局部机器人重新规划 [ 79 , 160 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Digital and embodied agents both revise plans after execution feedback, but recovery begins from materially different states. BacktrackAgent [ 192 ] detects GUI errors with verifier and judger modules and uses reflection to recover a productive interaction state using logged outcome pages and interaction history. This example does not make digital actions universally reversible: external services, permissions, and irreversible transactions can also remove options. A failed physical commitment may instead distribute change across geometry, contact, material condition, tool availability, and consumed resources without leaving a complete transaction record. Subsequent planning must reconstruct the state that is actually recoverable, identify effects that require compensation, and account for options removed by the preceding action. Reversibility therefore enters planning before commitment and during recovery, because it determines which remedies remain admissible under the continuing task objective.
paragraphs.zh: 数字智能体与具身智能体都会在执行反馈后修订计划，但两者的恢复起点处于实质不同的状态。 BacktrackAgent [ 192 ] 使用验证器与判断器模块检测 GUI 错误，并利用记录的结果页面和交互历史，通过反思恢复到一个可继续有效交互的状态。 这个例子并不意味着数字动作都是普遍可逆的：外部服务、权限和不可逆事务同样会使某些选项消失。 一次失败的物理行动反而可能把改变分散到几何结构、接触关系、材料状态、工具可用性和已消耗的资源之中，且不会留下完整的事务记录。 后续规划必须重构实际可恢复的状态，识别需要补偿的效果，并考虑前一个动作所消除的选项。 因此，可逆性在行动承诺之前和恢复过程中都会进入规划，因为它决定了在持续的任务目标下哪些补救手段仍然可行。

paragraphs.en: Robot planning can construct or refine a course within a specified goal and constraint model. PDDLStream [ 51 ] integrates symbolic search with black-box samplers, while ReKep [ 80 ] optimizes staged relational constraints for manipulation. Task-integrated embodied examples expose the return path: Inner Monologue [ 79 ] uses scene and success feedback to select a subsequent skill, and KnowNo [ 160 ] makes calibrated help-seeking an admissible planning outcome. This relation does not transfer unlimited orchestration into Plan. Plan remains responsible for authorizing or revising a course under the persistent goal and constraints; Perceive updates the task belief, Verify judges the observed outcome, and a scheduler may route the resulting decision. Assistance, stopping, or recovery belongs to Plan only when it is the selected course returned to the task process. A safety controller or human may retain veto authority without becoming the planner; if the human chooses every subsequent task action, the system instead has a human-in-the-loop Plan profile.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人规划可以在给定的目标与约束模型下构建或优化行动方案。 PDDLStream [ 51 ] 将符号搜索与黑盒采样器相结合，而 ReKep [ 80 ] 则针对操作任务优化分阶段的关系约束。 任务集成的具身示例揭示了返回路径：Inner Monologue [ 79 ] 利用场景与成功反馈来选择后续技能，而 KnowNo [ 160 ] 将经过校准的求助作为一种可采纳的规划结果。 这一关系并不会将无限制的编排转移进 Plan。 Plan 仍然负责在持续的目标与约束下授权或修订行动方案；Perceive 更新任务信念，Verify 判断观察到的结果，而调度器可以对由此产生的决策进行路由。 只有当协助、停止或恢复是返回给任务流程的所选行动方案时，它才属于 Plan。 安全控制器或人类可以保留否决权而不成为规划者；如果人类选择每一个后续任务动作，那么系统反而具有人在回路的 Plan 形态。

sents.en: Task-integrated embodied examples expose the return path: Inner Monologue [ 79 ] uses scene and success feedback to select a subsequent skill, and KnowNo [ 160 ] makes calibrated help-seeking an admissible planning outcome.
sents.zh: 任务集成的具身示例揭示了返回路径：Inner Monologue [ 79 ] 利用场景与成功反馈来选择后续技能，而 KnowNo [ 160 ] 将经过校准的求助作为一种可采纳的规划结果。

sents.en: This relation does not transfer unlimited orchestration into Plan.
sents.zh: 这一关系并不会将无限制的编排转移进 Plan。

sents.en: Plan remains responsible for authorizing or revising a course under the persistent goal and constraints; Perceive updates the task belief, Verify judges the observed outcome, and a scheduler may route the resulting decision.
sents.zh: Plan 仍然负责在持续的目标与约束下授权或修订行动方案；Perceive 更新任务信念，Verify 判断观察到的结果，而调度器可以对由此产生的决策进行路由。

sents.en: Assistance, stopping, or recovery belongs to Plan only when it is the selected course returned to the task process.
sents.zh: 只有当协助、停止或恢复是返回给任务流程的所选行动方案时，它才属于 Plan。

sents.en: A safety controller or human may retain veto authority without becoming the planner; if the human chooses every subsequent task action, the system instead has a human-in-the-loop Plan profile.
sents.zh: 安全控制器或人类可以保留否决权而不成为规划者；如果人类选择每一个后续任务动作，那么系统反而具有人在回路的 Plan 形态。

paragraphs.en: Plan returns an authorized course under the current goal, belief, anticipated consequences, and constraints. Before commitment, the course may preserve recovery branches or choose assistance instead of physical action. After an outcome, Plan re-enters the loop only when the system selects a revised course. This boundary leaves state estimation to Perceive, outcome adjudication to Verify, and physical realization to Act. Analysis should record preconditions, protected constraints, the selected commitment, and retained recovery branches. Annotated traces can measure precondition coverage and uncompensated persistent errors; option value and expected recovery cost require branching rollouts, replay, or an explicit reachability model. Planning quality can thus reflect both the selected course and the safe, reachable alternatives it preserves, without absorbing every recovery operation into Plan.
paragraphs.zh: Plan 在当前目标、信念、预期后果和约束条件下返回一条经授权的行动路线。 在承诺之前，该路线可以保留恢复分支，或选择协助而非物理行动。 在产生结果之后，只有当系统选择了一条修订后的路线时，Plan 才会重新进入循环。 这一边界将状态估计留给 Perceive，将结果裁定留给 Verify，将物理实现留给 Act。 分析应记录前置条件、受保护的约束、所选的承诺以及保留的恢复分支。 带标注的轨迹可以度量前置条件覆盖率和未补偿的持续性错误；而选项价值和预期恢复成本则需要分支推演、回放或显式的可达性模型。 因此，规划质量既能反映所选路线，也能反映它所保留的安全、可达的备选方案，而无须将每一次恢复操作都纳入 Plan。

paragraphs.en: Acting executes a selected action through the agent’s interface or body. Action grounding translates intent into targets, parameters, coordinates, or control signals that the environment accepts. Closed-loop execution uses feedback to adjust commands as the action proceeds. Errors in grounding can cause even a correct plan to fail. In physical environments, execution must continue while the agent computes its next action. Asynchronous policies address this by executing one trajectory segment while generating the next. The new segment can adjust or replace the remaining motion [ 11 , 167 ] . Execution must also account for the robot’s body, since the same instruction may require different movements across robot designs. Action representations and tokenization therefore shape how a policy generates executable motion [ 44 , 95 ] . Figure 8 compares how actions reach the environment and how execution feedback remains available to the ongoing task process.
paragraphs.zh: 行动通过智能体的接口或身体执行所选定的动作。 动作落地将意图转换为环境可接受的目标、参数、坐标或控制信号。 闭环执行在动作进行过程中利用反馈来调整指令。 落地中的错误即使有正确的规划也可能导致失败。 在物理环境中，智能体计算下一步动作时执行必须持续进行。 异步策略通过在生成下一段轨迹的同时执行当前轨迹段来解决这一问题。 新生成的段可以调整或替换剩余的运动 [ 11 , 167 ] 。 执行还必须考虑机器人的身体，因为同一指令在不同机器人设计上可能需要不同的运动。 因此，动作表示与分词方式决定了策略如何生成可执行的运动 [ 44 , 95 ] 。 图 8 对比了动作如何到达环境，以及执行反馈如何在持续的任务过程中保持可用。

paragraphs.en: Plan supplies a semantic intervention; Act must still ground its target, primitive, arguments, and reference frame in the available action space. For a multimodal agent, “click Submit” may resolve to a GUI element and coordinate, an API call, a typed command, or code [ 67 , 205 , 233 ] . For a robot, “pick up the cup” may resolve to an object, arm, coordinate frame, grasp pose, skill, or control target [ 88 , 27 ] . OS-Copilot [ 193 ] performs this grounding across web, terminal, file, multimedia, and application interfaces, whereas RT-2 [ 13 ] maps visual observations and language to robot actions. The targets differ, but the information product is the same: an environment-specific action specification accepted by the relevant interface or controller.
paragraphs.zh: 规划提供的是语义层面的干预；行动仍必须在可用的动作空间中落实其目标、原语、参数和参考坐标系。 对于多模态智能体，“点击提交”可能被解析为 GUI 元素和坐标、一次 API 调用、一条键入命令，或一段代码 [ 67 , 205 , 233 ] 。 对于机器人，“拿起杯子”可能被解析为一个物体、机械臂、坐标系、抓取位姿、一项技能，或一个控制目标 [ 88 , 27 ] 。 OS-Copilot [ 193 ] 在网页、终端、文件、多媒体和应用程序接口等多种界面中执行这种落地（grounding），而 RT-2 [ 13 ] 则将视觉观察和语言映射为机器人动作。 目标各不相同，但信息产物是相同的：一份被相关接口或控制器接受的环境特定的动作规格说明。

paragraphs.en: Grounding alone leaves an internal specification that must be decoded at the representation and temporal granularity required by the interface. Digital outputs include screen coordinates, structured GUI operations, commands, tool or API calls, code, and streams of discrete actions [ 32 , 54 , 71 , 233 , 114 , 111 ] ; robotic outputs include action tokens, chunks, waypoints, and continuous trajectories [ 88 , 14 , 13 , 232 , 207 ] . ShowUI [ 114 ] emits GUI operations with interface locations, while RT-2 [ 13 ] generates robot actions as tokens. STEVE-1 [ 111 ] produces keyboard and mouse sequences; ACT [ 232 ] predicts short robot-action chunks; Diffusion Policy [ 34 ] and RDT [ 118 ] generate continuous chunks through diffusion, whereas π 0 \pi_{0} [ 12 ] uses flow matching. ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] carries this robotic recipe back into computer-use: a lightweight flow-matching action expert generates continuous cursor trajectories for drags from streaming screenshots, while discrete clicks remain in the same model, so a GUI drag is treated as a closed-loop continuous action rather than a pair of coordinates. These implementations are domain-specific, but each converts intent into executable form and can condition subsequent action on newly observed environmental feedback during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 仅有接地（grounding）只能得到一份内部规格，还必须在接口所需的表示粒度和时间粒度上进行解码。 数字输出包括屏幕坐标、结构化的图形界面操作、命令、工具或 API 调用、代码以及离散动作流 [ 32 , 54 , 71 , 233 , 114 , 111 ]；机器人输出包括动作词元、动作块、路径点和连续轨迹 [ 88 , 14 , 13 , 232 , 207 ]。 ShowUI [ 114 ] 输出带有界面位置的图形界面操作，而 RT-2 [ 13 ] 以词元的形式生成机器人动作。 STEVE-1 [ 111 ] 生成键盘和鼠标序列；ACT [ 232 ] 预测短机器人动作块；Diffusion Policy [ 34 ] 和 RDT [ 118 ] 通过扩散生成连续动作块，而 π 0 \pi_{0} [ 12 ] 则使用流匹配。 ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] 将这一机器人领域的配方带回计算机使用场景：一个轻量级的流匹配动作专家从流式截图中为拖拽操作生成连续的光标轨迹，而离散的点击操作仍由同一模型完成，因此图形界面的拖拽被视为闭环的连续动作，而非一对坐标。 这些实现都是特定于领域的，但每一个都能将意图转化为可执行的形式，并且能够在执行过程中根据新观察到的环境反馈来条件化后续动作。

paragraphs.en: The shared execution relation grounds a selected intervention in an environment-specific target and action space, encodes it at an executable temporal granularity, and permits correction as observations arrive [ 32 , 13 , 167 ] . This explains how intent becomes command, but not how task-level meaning remains connected to body-specific control during physical execution [ 11 ] . Relative to MMAs, a compact agent-facing operation [ 198 ] must expand into a two-way interface for temporally extended execution [ 11 ] . Relative to goal-conditioned robot policies [ 13 , 232 , 34 ] , body-specific control becomes task-integrated only when its execution state remains visible to, and consequential for, the ongoing task process throughout the full duration of the embodied intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 共享的执行关系将选定的干预落实于特定环境的目标与动作空间，以可执行的时间粒度对其进行编码，并允许在观测到来时进行修正 [ 32 , 13 , 167 ] 。 这解释了意图如何变成命令，却没有解释任务层面的含义在物理执行过程中如何保持与特定身体控制的联系 [ 11 ] 。 相对于多模态智能体（MMA），面向智能体的紧凑操作 [ 198 ] 必须扩展为用于时间上延展执行的双向接口 [ 11 ] 。 相对于目标条件机器人策略 [ 13 , 232 , 34 ] ，特定身体的控制只有在以下情况下才能实现任务整合：其执行状态在整个具身干预的全过程中始终对正在进行的任务过程可见，并对该过程产生影响。

paragraphs.en: MMA environments can expose relatively compact agent-facing operations. OSWorld [ 198 ] , for example, presents clicks, text entry, code, and other platform-defined interfaces to the agent. This compactness is a property of the interface rather than of the setting: dragging a slider or a timeline already demands on-the-fly perception and adjustment, and ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] meets it with the action expert borrowed from robot policies [ 12 ] . Physical execution extends the same requirement across embodiment and time: a particular body must realize the semantic commitment while the task process retains access to its progress. A bidirectional execution contract makes this relation observable. Its downward record identifies the capability, target, parameters, preconditions, and admissible interruption points; its upward record may include controller state, estimated state change, progress, termination status, low-level faults, and observation time. The two directions keep the task meaning of the commitment traceable while leaving implementation and timing to embodiment-specific control. These fields are proposed observability criteria, not a claim that current MMEAs share a standardized execution API.
paragraphs.zh: MMA 环境可以暴露相对紧凑的面向智能体的操作。 例如，OSWorld [ 198 ] 向智能体呈现点击、文本输入、代码以及其他由平台定义的接口。 这种紧凑性是接口的属性而非环境的属性：拖动滑块或时间轴本身就已经要求即时的感知与调整，而 ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] 借用机器人策略 [ 12 ] 中的动作专家来满足这一要求。 物理执行将同样的要求延伸到具身与时间维度：特定的身体必须实现语义承诺，同时任务过程仍能访问其进度。 双向执行契约使这种关系变得可观察。 其下行记录标识能力、目标、参数、前置条件以及允许的中断点；其上行记录可包括控制器状态、估计的状态变化、进度、终止状态、底层故障以及观测时间。 这两个方向使承诺的任务语义保持可追溯，同时将实现与时机留给特定具身形式的控制。 这些字段是提出的可观察性标准，并非声称当前的 MMEA 共享标准化的执行 API。

sents.zh: 其下行记录标识能力、目标、参数、前置条件以及允许的中断点；其上行记录可包括控制器状态、估计的状态变化、进度、终止状态、底层故障以及观测时间。

sents.en: The two directions keep the task meaning of the commitment traceable while leaving implementation and timing to embodiment-specific control.
sents.zh: 这两个方向使承诺的任务语义保持可追溯，同时将实现与时机留给特定具身形式的控制。

sents.en: These fields are proposed observability criteria, not a claim that current MMEAs share a standardized execution API.
sents.zh: 这些字段是提出的可观察性标准，并非声称当前的 MMEA 共享标准化的执行 API。

paragraphs.en: Robotic policies already realize compact objectives on particular bodies. RT-2 [ 13 ] tokenizes robot actions, whereas ACT [ 232 ] and Diffusion Policy [ 34 ] produce temporally extended motor sequences. Within PAPAV, these systems establish body-specific execution but not, by that fact alone, a task-integrated embodied Act relation. Attribution depends on whether the current task process retains the authorized semantic commitment and can use time-sensitive execution feedback while intervention remains useful. Coding should check whether the downward record identifies the target, intended state change, governing constraints, and interruption conditions, and whether the upward record exposes progress, termination, faults, and timing. Such telemetry neither substitutes for Perceive’s estimate of the physical state nor determines Verify’s postcondition verdict. An explicit API, a modular control stack, or an end-to-end policy can instantiate Act, provided that time-sensitive execution feedback can still modify the course.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人策略已经能够在特定载体上实现紧凑的目标。 RT-2 [13] 将机器人动作标记化，而 ACT [232] 与 Diffusion Policy [34] 则生成时间上延展的运动序列。 在 PAPAV 中，这些系统建立了针对特定载体的执行，但仅凭这一点并不构成任务整合的具身 Act 关系。 归因取决于当前任务过程是否保留了被授权的语义承诺，并且能够在干预仍然有效时利用时间敏感的执行反馈。 编码环节应检查下行记录是否标明了目标、预期的状态变化、起约束作用的条件以及中断条件，上行记录是否呈现了进度、终止、故障和时序信息。 这类遥测数据既不能替代 Perceive 对物理状态的估计，也不能决定 Verify 的后置条件判定。 显式 API、模块化控制栈或端到端策略都可以实例化 Act，前提是时间敏感的执行反馈仍能修改执行进程。

paragraphs.en: Act maintains continuity between an authorized intervention and its body-specific realization. Evaluation should measure grounding correctness, progress observability, termination-state accuracy, interruption latency, and missed deadlines when the interface exposes the necessary evidence. Semantic divergence should compare the authorized target, intended state change, and protected constraints with the execution record rather than compare two free-form explanations. These measures diagnose Act directly; the final task verdict remains Verify’s responsibility. Specialized control is compatible with task-level agency when the authorized commitment remains traceable and timely feedback can still change the course. Because the grounding-and-decoding relation is shared, action machinery also crosses the boundary: ShowUI- π \pi [ 73 ] transfers flow-based action generation from robot-use to GUI dragging, illustrating a shared Act mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: Act（行动）在授权干预与其针对具体身体的实现之间保持连续性。 当接口暴露出必要证据时，评估应测量落地正确性、进度可观察性、终止状态准确性、中断延迟以及错过的截止期限。 语义分歧应将授权目标、意图发生的状态变更和受保护的约束与执行记录进行比对，而不是比较两份自由格式的解释。 这些测量直接诊断 Act（行动）；最终任务判定仍由 Verify（验证）负责。 当授权承诺保持可追溯且及时反馈仍能改变进程时，专门化控制与任务级智能体性是兼容的。 由于落地与解码关系是共享的，动作机制同样跨越该边界：ShowUI-π \pi [73] 将基于流的动作生成从机器人操作迁移到 GUI 拖拽，说明了一个共享的 Act 机制。

paragraphs.en: Verification judges intended change, task progress, and constraint satisfaction from post-action evidence [ 99 , 35 , 169 ] . MMAs and RSs compare completion criteria with observed consequences, including GUI states, application data, camera observations, proprioception, contact signals, and execution traces. WebArena [ 239 ] and OSWorld [ 198 ] check page, application, or execution states; Inner Monologue [ 79 ] returns scene and success signals to planning; vision-language success detectors [ 38 ] infer outcomes from observations. Embodied verification remains retrospective, but physical interaction often lacks an independent, fully observable success signal. Perceive maintains a task-general belief; Verify tests goal-specific criteria against post-action evidence. Although learned evaluators support action selection [ 100 ] and progress rewards for learning [ 226 ] , within PAPAV, Verify assesses executed actions, supporting task correction and learning. Figure 9 distinguishes the evidence supporting an outcome judgment from the level at which that judgment is consumed.
paragraphs.zh: 验证（Verification）依据行动后的证据来判断意图变更、任务进展和约束满足情况 [ 99 , 35 , 169 ]。 多模态智能体（MMAs）和机器人系统（RSs）将完成标准与观察到的后果进行比较，包括 GUI 状态、应用数据、相机观测、本体感觉、接触信号和执行轨迹。 WebArena [ 239 ] 和 OSWorld [ 198 ] 检查页面、应用或执行状态；Inner Monologue [ 79 ] 将场景和成功信号返回给规划；视觉-语言成功检测器 [ 38 ] 从观测中推断结果。 具身验证仍然具有回溯性，但物理交互通常缺乏独立的、完全可观测的成功信号。 感知（Perceive）维护任务通用信念；验证（Verify）依据行动后的证据检验目标特定的标准。 尽管学习型评估器支持动作选择 [ 100 ] 和用于学习的过程奖励 [ 226 ] ，但在 PAPAV 内部，验证（Verify）评估的是已执行的动作，从而支持任务纠正和学习。 图 9 区分了支持结果判断的证据与该判断被消费的层级。

sents.zh: 验证（Verification）依据行动后的证据来判断意图变更、任务进展和约束满足情况 [ 99 , 35 , 169 ]。

sents.zh: 多模态智能体（MMAs）和机器人系统（RSs）将完成标准与观察到的后果进行比较，包括 GUI 状态、应用数据、相机观测、本体感觉、接触信号和执行轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Verification requires two grounded inputs: evidence of what occurred after an action and an independently specified account of what should have occurred [ 156 , 128 ] . In digital environments, such evidence may include tool returns, outcome pages, persistent interface states, and interaction histories; in physical environments, it may additionally include visual, proprioceptive, contact, force, and other temporally accumulated observations. These signals allow GUI agents to inspect state transitions and robots to reconstruct manipulation outcomes [ 122 , 192 , 58 , 49 ] . The corresponding reference may be a task goal, predicted next state, subgoal condition, or explicit success criterion. Self-Grounded Verification [ 7 ] addresses this problem by first eliciting task-completion criteria independently of the candidate trajectory and only then evaluating the trajectory against those criteria; importantly, the same mechanism is demonstrated across web agents, GUI agents, and robotic manipulation policies. Physical-domain critics additionally require causal, spatial, and affordance awareness, while runtime failure detectors must account for uncertainty and out-of-distribution execution states [ 199 , 200 ] . Earlier reflection-based methods establish useful feedback–revision loops, but self-generated critique alone does not guarantee correspondence with the actual environment [ 171 , 134 ] . Verification should therefore be grounded in independently specified criteria, multimodal observations, tool-accessible states, or calibrated anomaly evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 验证需要两个有依据的输入：一是关于动作发生后实际情况的证据，二是独立指定的关于本应发生什么情况的说明 [ 156 , 128 ] 。 在数字环境中，此类证据可能包括工具返回结果、结果页面、持久的界面状态和交互历史；在物理环境中，还可能额外包括视觉、本体感觉、接触、力以及其他随时间累积的观测信息。 这些信号使图形界面智能体能够检查状态转换，使机器人能够重建操作结果 [ 122 , 192 , 58 , 49 ] 。 相应的参照可以是任务目标、预测的下一状态、子目标条件或明确的成功标准。 自依据验证 [ 7 ] 通过首先独立于候选轨迹引出任务完成标准、然后再依据这些标准评估轨迹来解决这一问题；值得注意的是，同一机制已在网络智能体、图形界面智能体和机器人操作策略上得到验证。 物理领域的评判器还需要具备因果、空间和可供性意识，而运行时故障检测器则必须考虑不确定性以及分布外的执行状态 [ 199 , 200 ] 。 较早的基于反思的方法建立了有用的反馈—修正循环，但仅靠自我生成的批评并不能保证与实际环境相符 [ 171 , 134 ] 。 因此，验证应当基于独立指定的标准、多模态观测、可通过工具访问的状态或经过校准的异常证据。

paragraphs.en: Verification must convert the gap between expected and observed outcomes into feedback that regulates the loop, not merely a detached binary label. The verdict may distinguish terminal success, intermediate progress, recoverable mismatch, insufficient evidence, an invalid expectation, or persistent risk. Language-conditioned success classifiers and multimodal reward models turn observed state changes into execution signals that can also support policy learning [ 146 , 190 , 132 , 188 , 131 , 113 ] . In digital environments, application state or a failed tool return can reveal task progress; Voyager [ 186 ] combines environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification to revise later behavior. Physical verification can instead depend on object relations, poses, or contact. REFLECT [ 122 ] summarizes robot experience to diagnose failures, and DoReMi [ 61 ] recovers from plan–execution mismatch. An actionable verdict should locate the mismatch and indicate the corrective response, rather than report correctness alone.
paragraphs.zh: 验证必须把预期结果与观测结果之间的差距转化为调节循环的反馈，而不能只是一个疏离的二元标签。 判定结果可以区分终结性成功、中间进展、可恢复的不匹配、证据不足、无效的期望或持续性风险。 语言条件化的成功分类器与多模态奖励模型把观测到的状态变化转化为执行信号，这些信号还能支持策略学习 [ 146 , 190 , 132 , 188 , 131 , 113 ] 。 在数字环境中，应用状态或失败的工具返回可以揭示任务进展；Voyager [ 186 ] 结合环境反馈、执行错误和自我验证来修正后续行为。 物理验证则可以依赖物体关系、位姿或接触。 REFLECT [ 122 ] 总结机器人经验以诊断失败，DoReMi [ 61 ] 则从计划与执行的不匹配中恢复。 可操作的判定结果应当定位不匹配之处并指出纠正性响应，而不能仅仅报告正确与否。

paragraphs.en: Corrective feedback should distinguish outcome assessment from failure attribution. After a placement attempt, an object outside the target region indicates an unmet postcondition, but does not establish whether the cause was incorrect grounding, an unsuitable plan, or execution error. The verifier should report the failed condition and supporting evidence. This distinction helps the task process select an appropriate response without treating every failure as a planning error.
paragraphs.zh: 纠错性反馈应当把结果评估与失败归因区分开来。 在一次放置尝试之后，目标区域之外的物体表明后置条件未满足，但并不能确定原因是接地不正确、计划不合适，还是执行错误。 验证器应当报告未满足的条件以及支持性证据。 这一区分有助于任务流程选择合适的应对方式，而不是把每一次失败都当作规划错误。

sents.en: This distinction helps the task process select an appropriate response without treating every failure as a planning error.

paragraphs.en: Verify can support improvement beyond the current task. In a self-improvement loop, the agent uses evaluated experience to update its policy. The updated policy then generates further attempts and new evidence for verification. Verify supplies evidence for learning; the learning mechanism performs the update.
paragraphs.zh: 验证可以支持超越当前任务的改进。 在自我改进循环中，智能体利用经过评估的经验来更新其策略。 更新后的策略随后会产生更多的尝试和新的证据以供验证。 验证为学习提供证据；学习机制执行更新。

sents.en: Verify can support improvement beyond the current task.
sents.zh: 验证可以支持超越当前任务的改进。

sents.en: In a self-improvement loop, the agent uses evaluated experience to update its policy.
sents.zh: 在自我改进循环中，智能体利用经过评估的经验来更新其策略。

sents.en: The updated policy then generates further attempts and new evidence for verification.
sents.zh: 更新后的策略随后会产生更多的尝试和新的证据以供验证。

sents.en: Verify supplies evidence for learning; the learning mechanism performs the update.
sents.zh: 验证为学习提供证据；学习机制执行更新。

paragraphs.en: VERITAS reuses successful trajectories collected under verifier guidance for policy training [ 227 ] . VLAC and EVOLVE-VLA use learned progress feedback to support policy updates through interaction [ 223 , 10 ] . These methods connect evaluation signals to policy improvement. A successful retry alone does not demonstrate a lasting improvement. The claim requires a retained update and better performance in subsequent evaluation. Incorrect judgments can admit failed behavior into training data or reward unhelpful actions.
paragraphs.zh: VERITAS 复用在验证器引导下收集的成功轨迹用于策略训练 [ 227 ]。 VLAC 和 EVOLVE-VLA 使用学习到的进度反馈，通过交互支持策略更新 [ 223 , 10 ]。 这些方法将评估信号与策略改进联系起来。 仅仅一次成功的重试并不能证明持久的改进。 这一主张需要保留的更新以及在后续评估中更好的表现。 错误的判断可能将失败的行为纳入训练数据，或奖励无益的动作。

paragraphs.en: Verification closes the loop by comparing post-action evidence with independently specified expectations [ 7 , 128 ] and returning a judgment that can regulate later execution [ 122 ] . Physical evidence may be partial or delayed [ 2 , 121 ] , observations uncertain [ 200 ] , and the verifier dependent on the same evidence as the acting stack. The MMA comparison therefore moves from software-mediated functional checks [ 239 , 106 ] to physical verdicts whose timing and dependencies shape reliability [ 199 ] . The robotics comparison asks whether an outcome signal remains local to monitoring or reaches the task process in time to influence the same episode [ 38 , 61 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 验证通过将行动后的证据与独立设定的预期进行比较来闭合回路[7, 128]，并返回一个能够调节后续执行的判断[122]。 物理证据可能不完整或有延迟[2, 121]，观测可能不确定[200]，且验证器可能依赖于与执行栈相同的证据。 因此，MMA 比较从软件中介的功能检查[239, 106]转向物理裁定，而物理裁定的时间与依赖关系会影响可靠性[199]。 机器人学比较关注结果信号是否仅停留在监控环节，还是能够及时到达任务过程以影响同一回合[38, 61]。

paragraphs.en: Digital evaluation must be separated from agent-side verification. WebArena [ 239 ] uses external programs to judge functional correctness, whereas MobileUse [ 106 ] places hierarchical reflection and recovery inside the agent’s ongoing task loop. Only the latter establishes an agent-consumed Verify relation. In an MMEA, the judgment rests on post-action physical evidence affected by partial visibility, sensor uncertainty, and delayed consequences. Timeliness becomes part of correctness: a verdict must reach the task process while continuation, renewed perception, replanning, recovery, assistance, or stopping can still change the outcome. Analysis should therefore record the verifier’s evidential-dependency profile. Shared sensors, representations, model backbones, or training data may produce correlated errors despite architectural separation, so verification records should disclose provenance and dependencies and quantify correlated failures wherever the evaluation design supports comparison against the policy that produced the action under evaluation. Uncertain verdicts may become unreliable training targets. Repeated updates can reinforce errors shared by the actor and verifier. Later evaluation should therefore check improvement against observed task outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 数字化评估必须与智能体侧的验证相分离。 WebArena [ 239 ] 使用外部程序来判断功能正确性，而 MobileUse [ 106 ] 则将分层反思与恢复置于智能体正在进行的任务循环之内。 只有后者建立了可供智能体消费的验证关系。 在 MMEA 中，判断依据的是动作执行之后的物理证据，而这些证据会受到部分可观测性、传感器不确定性和延迟后果的影响。 时效性成为正确性的一部分：裁决必须在任务过程仍能通过继续执行、重新感知、重新规划、恢复、求助或停止来改变结果时送达。 因此，分析应当记录验证者的证据依赖特征。 共享的传感器、表征、模型骨干或训练数据可能在架构分离的情况下仍产生相关错误，因此验证记录应当披露来源与依赖关系，并且在评估设计支持与产生被评估动作的策略进行对比时，量化相关失败。 不确定的裁决可能变成不可靠的训练目标。 反复更新会不断强化执行者与验证者共享的错误。 因此，后续评估应当对照观察到的任务结果来检查改进情况。

paragraphs.en: Robotic outcome detectors can serve training, offline evaluation, local control, or the ongoing task process. Vision-Language Models as Success Detectors [ 38 ] turns observed behavior into a reward or evaluation signal; this output alone does not show that a task-level agent consumes the verdict during the episode. DoReMi [ 61 ] , which appears here as task-integrated embodied evidence, instead detects plan–execution mismatch and routes the result into corrective replanning. Verify acquires its task-integrated embodied role when an actionable verdict reaches the current task process before selection of the next course. Coding should record the judged outcome, confidence, supporting evidence, unresolved conditions, consumer, and intervention window. A controller stop, a task-level verdict, and an offline label may share a detector while retaining different responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人化的结果检测器可以服务于训练、离线评估、局部控制或正在进行的任务过程。 视觉-语言模型作为成功检测器[38]将观察到的行为转化为奖励或评估信号；仅凭这一输出并不能表明任务级智能体在回合过程中消费该判定结果。 DoReMi[61]在此处作为任务融合的具身证据出现，它检测计划与执行之间的不匹配，并将检测结果引入纠正性的重新规划。 当一个可操作的判定结果在选择下一个行动方案之前到达当前任务过程时，Verify 便获得了其任务融合的具身角色。 编码应记录被判定出的结果、置信度、支持证据、未解决的条件、消费方以及干预窗口。 控制器停止、任务级判定与离线标签可以共享同一个检测器，同时保留各自不同的职责。

paragraphs.en: Verify adjudicates whether post-action evidence satisfies task postconditions and returns a verdict that can change the current episode, including termination. Act may provide execution telemetry and low-level faults; Verify assigns success, failure, partial progress, or unresolved uncertainty against task criteria. Annotated episodes support direct measurement of false acceptance, false rejection, calibration error, and verdict latency. Intervention benefit and recovery utility are causal quantities that require matched runs, randomized verifier use, branching replay, or an explicit causal estimator. Reports should pair verdict accuracy with evidence sources, dependencies on the acting system, and correlated errors. They should also identify who uses the verdict and when intervention remains possible. For self-improvement, evaluation should test whether the retained update improves performance in further trials under comparable conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 验证（Verify）判断动作后证据是否满足任务后置条件，并返回可以改变当前回合（包括终止回合）的裁定。 行动（Act）可以提供执行遥测数据和低级故障；验证（Verify）依据任务标准判定成功、失败、部分进展或未解决的不确定性。 带标注的回合支持对错误接受率、错误拒绝率、校准误差和裁定延迟进行直接测量。 干预收益和恢复效用是因果量，需要匹配的运行、随机化的验证器使用、分支重放或显式的因果估计器。 报告应将裁定准确性与证据来源、对行动系统的依赖以及相关性错误配对呈现。 报告还应指出谁在使用裁定结果，以及何时仍有可能进行干预。 对于自我改进，评估应检验所保留的更新在可比条件下是否能在后续试验中提升性能。

paragraphs.en: PAPAV capabilities serve the same core functions across digital and physical systems. Physical embodiment changes how these functions are carried out. The comparison with MMAs shows how physical interaction changes multimodal sensing, prediction, planning, execution, and outcome verification. The comparison with RSs examines how these capabilities inform ongoing task decisions. The analysis considers individual capabilities and how their outputs guide subsequent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: PAPAV 能力在数字系统与物理系统中承担相同的核心功能。 物理实体形态改变了这些功能的实现方式。 与 MMA 的对比展示了物理交互如何改变多模态感知、预测、规划、执行与结果验证。 与 RS 的对比考察了这些能力如何为进行中的任务决策提供依据。 该分析既考虑单项能力，也考虑它们的输出如何引导后续行为。

paragraphs.en: Studies spanning digital and physical environments provide evidence for shared capabilities [ 178 ] . Recent work also examines capability coordination, failure diagnosis, and interactive system evaluation [ 202 , 219 , 33 ] . These findings support capability analysis. Classification of complete systems follows the conditions in Section 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 跨越数字环境与物理环境的研究为共享能力提供了证据 [178]。 近期工作还考察了能力协调、故障诊断与交互式系统评估 [202, 219, 33]。 这些发现支持能力分析。 对完整系统的分类遵循 2.3 节中的条件。

sents.en: Classification of complete systems follows the conditions in Section 2.3 .
sents.zh: 对完整系统的分类遵循 2.3 节中的条件。

paragraphs.en: The PAPAV framework guides the analysis of benchmark coverage. For each capability, evaluation should identify its inputs, outputs, and role in task decisions. It should also specify whether the capability is explicitly assessed. Further analysis should examine how uncertainty, execution feedback, and recovery affect later decisions. Some systems continue to learn through interaction. Their evaluation should identify what is updated and whether these changes persist over repeated interactions. Further trials should test their effects on task performance under comparable conditions. A successful retry alone does not demonstrate lasting improvement. Section 4 examines how existing benchmarks assess the five capabilities and where gaps in evaluation remain.
paragraphs.zh: PAPAV 框架用于指导对基准测试覆盖范围的分析。 对于每项能力，评估应识别其输入、输出以及在任务决策中的作用。 还应明确该能力是否被显式评估。 进一步分析应考察不确定性、执行反馈和恢复如何影响后续决策。 有些系统会通过交互持续学习。 对这类系统的评估应识别更新了什么内容，以及这些变化是否在多次交互中持续存在。 应通过进一步的试验，在可比条件下检验这些变化对任务表现的影响。 仅仅一次成功的重试并不能证明持久的改进。 第 4 节考察现有基准测试如何评估这五项能力，以及评估中仍存在哪些空白。

sents.en: Section 4 examines how existing benchmarks assess the five capabilities and where gaps in evaluation remain.
sents.zh: 第 4 节考察现有基准测试如何评估这五项能力，以及评估中仍存在哪些空白。

paragraphs.en: This section compares how existing benchmarks evaluate PAPAV capabilities across multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs), multimodal agents (MMAs), and robotic systems (RSs). We distinguish task requirements from explicit evaluation:a task may require a capability, but overall outcome metrics do not reveal how well the agent performs that capability. Our curated corpus contains 64 benchmarks: 10 MMEA, 23 MMA, and 31 RS benchmarks. Table 2 summarizes their information, task settings, and PAPAV coverage. All counts and proportions refer to this corpus unless stated otherwise.
paragraphs.zh: 本节比较现有基准如何评估PAPAV在多模态具身智能体（MMEA）、多模态智能体（MMA）和机器人系统（RS）中的能力。 我们将任务要求与显式评估区分开来：一个任务可能需要某种能力，但整体结果指标并不能揭示智能体执行该能力的表现如何。 我们精选的语料库包含64个基准：10个MMEA基准、23个MMA基准和31个RS基准。 表2总结了它们的信息、任务设置和PAPAV覆盖情况。 除非另有说明，所有计数和比例均指该语料库。

sents.en: This section compares how existing benchmarks evaluate PAPAV capabilities across multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs), multimodal agents (MMAs), and robotic systems (RSs).
sents.zh: 本节比较现有基准如何评估PAPAV在多模态具身智能体（MMEA）、多模态智能体（MMA）和机器人系统（RS）中的能力。

sents.zh: 我们精选的语料库包含64个基准：10个MMEA基准、23个MMA基准和31个RS基准。

sents.en: Table 2 summarizes their information, task settings, and PAPAV coverage.
sents.zh: 表2总结了它们的信息、任务设置和PAPAV覆盖情况。

paragraphs.en: Candidates were identified through Google Scholar and relevant publication venues. Inclusion required defined tasks or environments, a public protocol with at least one quantitative metric, PAPAV relevance, and sufficient evidence for capability labeling. Successor benchmarks were counted separately only if tasks, environments, datasets, or protocols changed substantially. Benchmarks were assigned to mutually exclusive MMEA, MMA, and RS categories by their primary evaluation domains; multimodal input alone did not qualify an RS benchmark as MMEA. The corpus was last updated on 8 Sept 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 候选基准通过 Google Scholar 及相关出版物渠道进行识别。 纳入标准要求：具有明确的任务或环境、拥有至少一个量化指标的公开协议、与 PAPAV 相关，以及足以支持能力标注的证据。 仅当任务、环境、数据集或协议发生实质性变化时，后续基准才被单独计数。 基准根据其主要评估领域被划分到互斥的 MMEA、MMA 和 RS 三个类别；仅具备多模态输入并不足以将一个 RS 基准归为 MMEA。 本语料库最后更新于 2026 年 9 月 8 日。

sents.zh: 候选基准通过 Google Scholar 及相关出版物渠道进行识别。

sents.zh: 纳入标准要求：具有明确的任务或环境、拥有至少一个量化指标的公开协议、与 PAPAV 相关，以及足以支持能力标注的证据。
