sents.zh: 在这些条件下，仅让每项能力孤立地提升是不够的。

sents.en: The agent must decide what information to retain, which future consequences to predict, when to revise a plan, how to act under uncertainty, and how verification can improve later behavior.
sents.zh: 智能体必须决定保留哪些信息、预测哪些未来后果、何时修订计划、如何在不确定性下行动，以及验证如何改进后续行为。

sents.en: We organize these five challenges in PAPAV order.
sents.zh: 我们按 PAPAV 的顺序组织这五项挑战。

paragraphs.en: A robot never has the physical world fully available in its current observation. Objects move out of view, properties become hidden by occlusion, and the effects of earlier actions can remain important long after the evidence has disappeared. Classical state estimation and mapping already provide mechanisms for carrying information forward in time [ 17 ] ; more recent open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs extend this idea toward persistent semantic entities and relations [ 56 , 135 ] . Yet persistence alone is not enough. Unlike a static log, a physical belief must change when the world changes.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人在其当前观测中永远无法完整获取物理世界的全部信息。 物体会移出视野，属性会因遮挡而隐藏，而早期动作的影响可能在证据消失后很长时间内仍然重要。 经典的状态估计与建图已经提供了将信息随时间向前传递的机制 [ 17 ] ；较新的开放词汇地图和场景图则将这一思想扩展到持久化的语义实体与关系 [ 56 , 135 ] 。 然而仅有持久性是不够的。 与静态日志不同，物理信念必须随世界的变化而改变。

sents.en: A robot never has the physical world fully available in its current observation.
sents.zh: 机器人在其当前观测中永远无法完整获取物理世界的全部信息。

sents.en: Objects move out of view, properties become hidden by occlusion, and the effects of earlier actions can remain important long after the evidence has disappeared.
sents.zh: 物体会移出视野，属性会因遮挡而隐藏，而早期动作的影响可能在证据消失后很长时间内仍然重要。

sents.zh: 经典的状态估计与建图已经提供了将信息随时间向前传递的机制 [ 17 ] ；较新的开放词汇地图和场景图则将这一思想扩展到持久化的语义实体与关系 [ 56 , 135 ] 。

sents.en: Yet persistence alone is not enough.
sents.zh: 然而仅有持久性是不够的。

sents.en: Unlike a static log, a physical belief must change when the world changes.
sents.zh: 与静态日志不同，物理信念必须随世界的变化而改变。

paragraphs.en: This creates a tension that is easy to overlook. Forgetting too aggressively causes the agent to repeatedly rediscover state it has already observed, while retaining everything allows stale or contradictory information to accumulate. Structured maps make beliefs explicit and editable; latent recurrent states can compress long histories; episodic retrieval can recover fine-grained evidence only when it becomes relevant. None of these properties alone determines what the agent should continue to believe.
paragraphs.zh: 这造成了一种容易被忽视的张力。 过于激进地遗忘会导致智能体反复重新发现自己已经观察过的状态，而保留一切则会让过时或矛盾的信息不断累积。 结构化地图使信念显式且可编辑；潜在循环状态可以压缩漫长的历史；情景检索可以在细粒度证据变得相关时才将其找回。 这些特性中的任何一个都不能单独决定智能体应当继续相信什么。

sents.en: This creates a tension that is easy to overlook.
sents.zh: 这造成了一种容易被忽视的张力。

sents.en: Forgetting too aggressively causes the agent to repeatedly rediscover state it has already observed, while retaining everything allows stale or contradictory information to accumulate.
sents.zh: 过于激进地遗忘会导致智能体反复重新发现自己已经观察过的状态，而保留一切则会让过时或矛盾的信息不断累积。

sents.en: Structured maps make beliefs explicit and editable; latent recurrent states can compress long histories; episodic retrieval can recover fine-grained evidence only when it becomes relevant.
sents.zh: 结构化地图使信念显式且可编辑；潜在循环状态可以压缩漫长的历史；情景检索可以在细粒度证据变得相关时才将其找回。

sents.en: None of these properties alone determines what the agent should continue to believe.
sents.zh: 这些特性中的任何一个都不能单独决定智能体应当继续相信什么。

paragraphs.en: Core question: What should an embodied agent retain, revise, or forget as the world changes?
paragraphs.zh: 核心问题：随着世界的变化，一个具身智能体应该保留、修改或遗忘什么？

paragraphs.en: The central issue is therefore not memory capacity, but the quality of the belief that memory supports. A useful memory should preserve information that is temporarily unobservable, revise it when new evidence disagrees, and make past experience available when it can change the next decision. This suggests that future systems may need to combine persistent structured state with compressed or episodic representations rather than choosing a single memory form.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，核心问题不在于记忆容量，而在于记忆所支撑的信念的质量。 一个有用的记忆应当保存暂时不可观察的信息，在新证据与之相悖时加以修订，并在能够改变下一步决策时提供过去的经验。 这表明，未来的系统可能需要将持久的结构化状态与压缩的或情节式的表示相结合，而不是只选择单一的记忆形式。

sents.en: The central issue is therefore not memory capacity, but the quality of the belief that memory supports.
sents.zh: 因此，核心问题不在于记忆容量，而在于记忆所支撑的信念的质量。

sents.en: A useful memory should preserve information that is temporarily unobservable, revise it when new evidence disagrees, and make past experience available when it can change the next decision.
sents.zh: 一个有用的记忆应当保存暂时不可观察的信息，在新证据与之相悖时加以修订，并在能够改变下一步决策时提供过去的经验。

sents.en: This suggests that future systems may need to combine persistent structured state with compressed or episodic representations rather than choosing a single memory form.
sents.zh: 这表明，未来的系统可能需要将持久的结构化状态与压缩的或情节式的表示相结合，而不是只选择单一的记忆形式。

paragraphs.en: Correspondingly, evaluation should ask whether memory remains useful under occlusion and change: can the agent recover hidden-but-relevant state, correct stale beliefs, resolve contradictions, and make better downstream decisions without memory and retrieval cost growing without bound?
paragraphs.zh: 相应地，评估应当追问：在被遮挡与发生变化的情境下，记忆是否仍然有用——智能体能否恢复隐藏但相关的状态、纠正过时的信念、解决矛盾，并在记忆与检索成本不无限增长的前提下做出更好的下游决策？

paragraphs.en: Embodied agents can anticipate the future at very different levels of detail. Visual foresight predicts future observations under candidate actions [ 46 , 41 ] ; latent world models instead compress the dynamics into an internal state and reason through imagined trajectories [ 64 , 191 ] . Recent robotic world models further explore learned predictive representations for manipulation and robot imagination [ 240 , 242 ] . These approaches all support anticipation, but they do not agree on what must actually be predicted.
paragraphs.zh: 具身智能体能够在非常不同的细节层次上预见未来。 视觉预见模型在候选动作下预测未来的观测 [ 46 , 41 ] ；而潜在世界模型则将动力学压缩为内部状态，并通过想象出的轨迹进行推理 [ 64 , 191 ] 。 近期的机器人世界模型进一步探索了用于操作和机器人想象的可学习预测表示 [ 240 , 242 ] 。 这些方法都支持预见，但它们对究竟需要预测什么并没有达成一致。

sents.en: Embodied agents can anticipate the future at very different levels of detail.
sents.zh: 具身智能体能够在非常不同的细节层次上预见未来。

sents.en: Visual foresight predicts future observations under candidate actions [ 46 , 41 ] ; latent world models instead compress the dynamics into an internal state and reason through imagined trajectories [ 64 , 191 ] .
sents.zh: 视觉预见模型在候选动作下预测未来的观测 [ 46 , 41 ] ；而潜在世界模型则将动力学压缩为内部状态，并通过想象出的轨迹进行推理 [ 64 , 191 ] 。

sents.en: Recent robotic world models further explore learned predictive representations for manipulation and robot imagination [ 240 , 242 ] .
sents.zh: 近期的机器人世界模型进一步探索了用于操作和机器人想象的可学习预测表示 [ 240 , 242 ] 。

sents.en: These approaches all support anticipation, but they do not agree on what must actually be predicted.
sents.zh: 这些方法都支持预见，但它们对究竟需要预测什么并没有达成一致。

paragraphs.en: A high-fidelity future image may contain nearly every visible consequence of an action, yet much of that detail may be irrelevant to the choice at hand. Conversely, a compact latent prediction can be efficient while hiding the very factor that determines whether an action is safe or feasible. For some decisions, predicting an event such as collision likelihood, contact, reachability, progress, or risk may be more useful than reconstructing the future scene itself [ 92 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一张高保真的未来图像可能包含一个动作几乎所有的可见后果，但其中大量细节可能与当前的选择无关。 相反，一个紧凑的潜在预测虽然高效，却可能恰好隐藏了决定一个动作是否安全或可行的那个关键因素。 对于某些决策而言，预测诸如碰撞可能性、接触、可达性、进度或风险之类的事件，可能比重建未来场景本身更有用 [ 92 ] 。

sents.en: A high-fidelity future image may contain nearly every visible consequence of an action, yet much of that detail may be irrelevant to the choice at hand.
sents.zh: 一张高保真的未来图像可能包含一个动作几乎所有的可见后果，但其中大量细节可能与当前的选择无关。

sents.en: Conversely, a compact latent prediction can be efficient while hiding the very factor that determines whether an action is safe or feasible.
sents.zh: 相反，一个紧凑的潜在预测虽然高效，却可能恰好隐藏了决定一个动作是否安全或可行的那个关键因素。

sents.en: For some decisions, predicting an event such as collision likelihood, contact, reachability, progress, or risk may be more useful than reconstructing the future scene itself [ 92 ] .
sents.zh: 对于某些决策而言，预测诸如碰撞可能性、接触、可达性、进度或风险之类的事件，可能比重建未来场景本身更有用 [ 92 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Core question: What future information must an embodied agent predict to make a good decision?
paragraphs.zh: 核心问题：一个具身智能体必须预测哪些未来信息才能做出好的决策？

paragraphs.en: This suggests a different objective for world modeling. Rather than asking for the most realistic or complete forecast, the agent should predict enough of the future to preserve the distinctions that matter for action. What counts as sufficient prediction may therefore depend on both the task and the decision the agent is trying to make. The desired representation may change accordingly: geometric consequences may dominate navigation, contact and stability may matter for manipulation, and social responses or intent may become more important in human–robot interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明世界建模可以有一个不同的目标。 智能体不应追求最真实或最完整的预测，而应预测出足以保留那些对行动有意义的差异的未来。 因此，什么样的预测才算充分，可能既取决于任务，也取决于智能体试图做出的决策。 所需的表示也可能随之变化：在导航中几何后果可能占主导地位，在操作中接触与稳定性可能更重要，而在人机交互中社会反应或意图可能变得更加重要。

sents.en: This suggests a different objective for world modeling.
sents.zh: 这表明世界建模可以有一个不同的目标。

sents.en: Rather than asking for the most realistic or complete forecast, the agent should predict enough of the future to preserve the distinctions that matter for action.
sents.zh: 智能体不应追求最真实或最完整的预测，而应预测出足以保留那些对行动有意义的差异的未来。

sents.en: What counts as sufficient prediction may therefore depend on both the task and the decision the agent is trying to make.
sents.zh: 因此，什么样的预测才算充分，可能既取决于任务，也取决于智能体试图做出的决策。

sents.en: The desired representation may change accordingly: geometric consequences may dominate navigation, contact and stability may matter for manipulation, and social responses or intent may become more important in human–robot interaction.
sents.zh: 所需的表示也可能随之变化：在导航中几何后果可能占主导地位，在操作中接触与稳定性可能更重要，而在人机交互中社会反应或意图可能变得更加重要。

paragraphs.en: A practical way to test such sufficiency is to remove predictive detail and ask whether the resulting policy changes. If a simpler forecast preserves action ranking, safety judgments, and task outcomes, the omitted detail was not necessary for that decision. The open problem is to identify such decision-relevant representations without making them so narrow that they fail when the environment changes.
paragraphs.zh: 检验这种充分性的一个实用方法是删除具有预测作用的细节，然后观察由此产生的策略是否发生变化。 如果一个更简单的预测能保持行动排序、安全性判断和任务结果不变，那么被省略的细节对该决策而言并非必要。 未解决的难题在于，如何识别这类与决策相关的表征，同时又不使其过于狭窄，以免环境发生变化时失效。

sents.en: A practical way to test such sufficiency is to remove predictive detail and ask whether the resulting policy changes.
sents.zh: 检验这种充分性的一个实用方法是删除具有预测作用的细节，然后观察由此产生的策略是否发生变化。

sents.en: If a simpler forecast preserves action ranking, safety judgments, and task outcomes, the omitted detail was not necessary for that decision.
sents.zh: 如果一个更简单的预测能保持行动排序、安全性判断和任务结果不变，那么被省略的细节对该决策而言并非必要。

sents.en: The open problem is to identify such decision-relevant representations without making them so narrow that they fail when the environment changes.
sents.zh: 未解决的难题在于，如何识别这类与决策相关的表征，同时又不使其过于狭窄，以免环境发生变化时失效。

paragraphs.en: The granularity of action has become an increasingly important design choice. Policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers predict temporally coherent action sequences rather than isolated controls [ 232 ] . This can reduce repeated high-level inference and produce smoother execution. At the same time, longer chunks create a period during which the world may change while the agent is still committed to an earlier decision. Real-Time Chunking makes this tension explicit by asking how large policies can remain reactive when model inference is slower than physical execution [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 动作粒度已成为一个日益重要的设计选择。 诸如基于 Transformer 的动作分块（Action Chunking with Transformers）等策略预测的是时间上连贯的动作序列，而非孤立的控制指令 [ 232 ] 。 这可以减少重复的高层推理，并产生更平滑的执行。 与此同时，更长的分块会造成一段时间窗口，在此期间世界可能发生变化，而智能体仍在执行较早的决定。 实时分块（Real-Time Chunking）明确提出了这一矛盾：当模型推理速度慢于物理执行速度时，多大的策略仍能保持反应性 [ 11 ] 。

sents.en: The granularity of action has become an increasingly important design choice.
sents.zh: 动作粒度已成为一个日益重要的设计选择。

sents.en: Policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers predict temporally coherent action sequences rather than isolated controls [ 232 ] .
sents.zh: 诸如基于 Transformer 的动作分块（Action Chunking with Transformers）等策略预测的是时间上连贯的动作序列，而非孤立的控制指令 [ 232 ] 。

sents.en: This can reduce repeated high-level inference and produce smoother execution.
sents.zh: 这可以减少重复的高层推理，并产生更平滑的执行。

sents.en: At the same time, longer chunks create a period during which the world may change while the agent is still committed to an earlier decision.
sents.zh: 与此同时，更长的分块会造成一段时间窗口，在此期间世界可能发生变化，而智能体仍在执行较早的决定。

sents.en: Real-Time Chunking makes this tension explicit by asking how large policies can remain reactive when model inference is slower than physical execution [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 实时分块（Real-Time Chunking）明确提出了这一矛盾：当模型推理速度慢于物理执行速度时，多大的策略仍能保持反应性 [ 11 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Neither extreme is satisfactory. Replanning after every small motion is expensive and can make behavior hesitant; committing to a long action sequence can make the agent slow to react to contact, disturbances, or an incorrect belief. Closed-loop systems such as Inner Monologue already show why new scene and success information should feed back into later decisions [ 79 ] . What remains unclear is how frequently that loop should be reopened.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种极端都不令人满意。 每完成一个小动作就重新规划开销很大，而且会使行为显得犹豫不决；而一次性确定较长的动作序列，则会使智能体对接触、扰动或错误信念的反应变得迟缓。 诸如 Inner Monologue 这类闭环系统已经表明，为什么新的场景信息和成功信息应当反馈到后续决策中 [ 79 ] 。 尚不清楚的是，这个循环应以什么频率重新开启。

sents.en: Neither extreme is satisfactory.
sents.zh: 这两种极端都不令人满意。

sents.en: Replanning after every small motion is expensive and can make behavior hesitant; committing to a long action sequence can make the agent slow to react to contact, disturbances, or an incorrect belief.
sents.zh: 每完成一个小动作就重新规划开销很大，而且会使行为显得犹豫不决；而一次性确定较长的动作序列，则会使智能体对接触、扰动或错误信念的反应变得迟缓。

sents.en: Closed-loop systems such as Inner Monologue already show why new scene and success information should feed back into later decisions [ 79 ] .
sents.zh: 诸如 Inner Monologue 这类闭环系统已经表明，为什么新的场景信息和成功信息应当反馈到后续决策中 [ 79 ] 。

sents.en: What remains unclear is how frequently that loop should be reopened.
sents.zh: 尚不清楚的是，这个循环应以什么频率重新开启。

paragraphs.en: Core question: How long should an agent continue executing before observing and replanning?
paragraphs.zh: 核心问题：一个智能体在观察和重新规划之前，应该持续执行多长时间？

paragraphs.en: The appropriate horizon is unlikely to be fixed. Predictable free-space motion may tolerate longer commitment, whereas contact-rich interaction, unexpected motion, high uncertainty, or an irreversible action may justify checking again much sooner. In this view, action granularity becomes a control variable of the agent itself: the system adapts not only what it does, but also when it should think again.
paragraphs.zh: 合适的决策视界不太可能是固定的。 可预测的自由空间运动或许可以容忍更长的承诺周期，而接触丰富的交互、意外运动、高不确定性或不可逆的动作则可能需要更早地再次检查。 在这种视角下，动作粒度成为智能体自身的一个控制变量：系统不仅适应它做什么，还适应它何时应该重新思考。

sents.en: The appropriate horizon is unlikely to be fixed.
sents.zh: 合适的决策视界不太可能是固定的。

sents.en: Predictable free-space motion may tolerate longer commitment, whereas contact-rich interaction, unexpected motion, high uncertainty, or an irreversible action may justify checking again much sooner.
sents.zh: 可预测的自由空间运动或许可以容忍更长的承诺周期，而接触丰富的交互、意外运动、高不确定性或不可逆的动作则可能需要更早地再次检查。

sents.en: In this view, action granularity becomes a control variable of the agent itself: the system adapts not only what it does, but also when it should think again.
sents.zh: 在这种视角下，动作粒度成为智能体自身的一个控制变量：系统不仅适应它做什么，还适应它何时应该重新思考。

paragraphs.en: A convincing solution should therefore gain reactivity where it matters without paying the cost of constant replanning everywhere. Success rate alone will not capture this trade-off; reaction delay, wasted actions, intervention frequency, and inference cost are also important for determining whether adaptive commitment actually improves the closed loop.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，一个令人信服的解决方案应该在关键之处获得反应性，而不必在所有地方都付出持续重新规划的代价。 仅凭成功率无法体现这一权衡；反应延迟、浪费的动作、干预频率和推理成本对于判断自适应承诺是否真正改善了闭环同样至关重要。

sents.en: A convincing solution should therefore gain reactivity where it matters without paying the cost of constant replanning everywhere.
sents.zh: 因此，一个令人信服的解决方案应该在关键之处获得反应性，而不必在所有地方都付出持续重新规划的代价。

sents.en: Success rate alone will not capture this trade-off; reaction delay, wasted actions, intervention frequency, and inference cost are also important for determining whether adaptive commitment actually improves the closed loop.
sents.zh: 仅凭成功率无法体现这一权衡；反应延迟、浪费的动作、干预频率和推理成本对于判断自适应承诺是否真正改善了闭环同样至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Uncertainty appears throughout the embodied loop. An object may be partially occluded, an instruction may admit several interpretations, a scene may differ from the training distribution, or the outcome of an action may simply be hard to predict. In each case, uncertainty can affect not only what the agent believes, but also which action it should take and how cautiously it should proceed. Recent work has begun to make this uncertainty actionable: calibrated planners can ask for help [ 160 ] , active-perception systems can gather additional observations [ 53 , 124 ] , and runtime monitors can use uncertainty to detect situations in which the current policy may be unreliable [ 200 , 109 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 不确定性贯穿于具身回路之中。 物体可能被部分遮挡，指令可能存在多种解释，场景可能与训练分布不同，或者动作的结果可能难以预测。 在每一种情况下，不确定性不仅会影响智能体所相信的内容，还会影响它应采取的行动以及它应以何种谨慎程度推进。 近期的工作已开始使这种不确定性可被利用：经校准的规划器可以请求帮助 [ 160 ]，主动感知系统可以收集额外的观测 [ 53 , 124 ]，而运行时监控器可以利用不确定性来检测当前策略可能不可靠的情况 [ 200 , 109 ]。

sents.en: Uncertainty appears throughout the embodied loop.
sents.zh: 不确定性贯穿于具身回路之中。

sents.en: An object may be partially occluded, an instruction may admit several interpretations, a scene may differ from the training distribution, or the outcome of an action may simply be hard to predict.
sents.zh: 物体可能被部分遮挡，指令可能存在多种解释，场景可能与训练分布不同，或者动作的结果可能难以预测。

sents.en: In each case, uncertainty can affect not only what the agent believes, but also which action it should take and how cautiously it should proceed.
sents.zh: 在每一种情况下，不确定性不仅会影响智能体所相信的内容，还会影响它应采取的行动以及它应以何种谨慎程度推进。

sents.en: Recent work has begun to make this uncertainty actionable: calibrated planners can ask for help [ 160 ] , active-perception systems can gather additional observations [ 53 , 124 ] , and runtime monitors can use uncertainty to detect situations in which the current policy may be unreliable [ 200 , 109 ] .
sents.zh: 近期的工作已开始使这种不确定性可被利用：经校准的规划器可以请求帮助 [ 160 ]，主动感知系统可以收集额外的观测 [ 53 , 124 ]，而运行时监控器可以利用不确定性来检测当前策略可能不可靠的情况 [ 200 , 109 ]。

paragraphs.en: These mechanisms point to a control problem. More information is not always worth acquiring, and uncertainty does not always justify stopping. A slightly uncertain but reversible action may be worth attempting; the same uncertainty may be unacceptable before an irreversible or safety-critical action. Likewise, asking for help can prevent failure but defeats autonomy if used whenever confidence drops.
paragraphs.zh: 这些机制指向一个控制问题。 获取更多信息并不总是值得的，不确定性也不总是构成停止的理由。 一个略有不确定性但可逆的动作可能值得尝试；同样的不确定性在不可逆或安全攸关的动作之前可能是不可接受的。 同样，请求帮助可以避免失败，但若每当信心下降就使用，则会损害自主性。

sents.en: These mechanisms point to a control problem.
sents.zh: 这些机制指向一个控制问题。

sents.en: More information is not always worth acquiring, and uncertainty does not always justify stopping.
sents.zh: 获取更多信息并不总是值得的，不确定性也不总是构成停止的理由。

sents.en: A slightly uncertain but reversible action may be worth attempting; the same uncertainty may be unacceptable before an irreversible or safety-critical action.
sents.zh: 一个略有不确定性但可逆的动作可能值得尝试；同样的不确定性在不可逆或安全攸关的动作之前可能是不可接受的。

sents.en: Likewise, asking for help can prevent failure but defeats autonomy if used whenever confidence drops.
sents.zh: 同样，请求帮助可以避免失败，但若每当信心下降就使用，则会损害自主性。

paragraphs.en: Core question: When uncertain, should an agent act, gather more information, or ask for help?
paragraphs.zh: 核心问题：当不确定时，智能体应该行动、收集更多信息，还是寻求帮助？

paragraphs.en: The choice depends on more than calibrated confidence. The agent must also consider how costly another observation would be, whether it is likely to resolve the ambiguity, how reversible the proposed action is, and what happens if the decision is wrong. Uncertainty estimation therefore becomes useful only when it changes the control strategy of the loop.
paragraphs.zh: 这一选择不仅取决于校准后的置信度。 智能体还必须考虑再次获取观测的代价有多高、它是否可能消除歧义、拟议行动的可逆性如何，以及决策出错时会发生什么。 因此，只有当不确定性估计能够改变循环的控制策略时，它才真正有用。

sents.en: The choice depends on more than calibrated confidence.
sents.zh: 这一选择不仅取决于校准后的置信度。

sents.en: The agent must also consider how costly another observation would be, whether it is likely to resolve the ambiguity, how reversible the proposed action is, and what happens if the decision is wrong.
sents.zh: 智能体还必须考虑再次获取观测的代价有多高、它是否可能消除歧义、拟议行动的可逆性如何，以及决策出错时会发生什么。

sents.zh: 因此，只有当不确定性估计能够改变循环的控制策略时，它才真正有用。

paragraphs.en: This reframes the goal from “knowing when the model is uncertain” to choosing an appropriate response to that uncertainty. A capable agent should proceed when autonomous action is justified, seek information when it is likely to change the decision, and defer when the potential consequence of a mistake outweighs the cost of asking. The challenge is to achieve this balance without producing either reckless autonomy or a system that continually re-observes and escalates.
paragraphs.zh: 这将目标从“知道模型何时不确定”重新定义为对该不确定性选择合适的应对方式。 一个有能力的智能体应当在自主行动合理时继续行动，在获取信息可能改变决策时寻求信息，并在错误的潜在后果超过询问成本时选择推迟。 挑战在于实现这种平衡，既不产生鲁莽的自主行为，也不产生一个不断重复观察和不断上报的系统。

sents.zh: 这将目标从“知道模型何时不确定”重新定义为对该不确定性选择合适的应对方式。

paragraphs.en: Verification judges whether an action achieved its intended outcome. Its role in an improvement loop extends to guiding changes in later behavior. REFLECT [ 122 ] uses robot experience to explain failures and support correction. Reflexion [ 171 ] stores reflections on task feedback and uses them in later trials. These approaches motivate a broader question: how can feedback produce improvements that remain useful beyond the current attempt and across related tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 验证判断一个动作是否达成了其预期结果。 它在改进循环中的作用延伸到指导后续行为中的改变。 REFLECT [ 122 ] 利用机器人经验来解释失败并支持纠正。 Reflexion [ 171 ] 存储对任务反馈的反思，并在后续试验中使用它们。 这些方法引出一个更广泛的问题：反馈如何能产生在当前尝试之外以及跨相关任务仍然有用的改进？

sents.en: Verification judges whether an action achieved its intended outcome.
sents.zh: 验证判断一个动作是否达成了其预期结果。

sents.en: Its role in an improvement loop extends to guiding changes in later behavior.
sents.zh: 它在改进循环中的作用延伸到指导后续行为中的改变。

sents.en: REFLECT [ 122 ] uses robot experience to explain failures and support correction.
sents.zh: REFLECT [ 122 ] 利用机器人经验来解释失败并支持纠正。

sents.en: Reflexion [ 171 ] stores reflections on task feedback and uses them in later trials.
sents.zh: Reflexion [ 171 ] 存储对任务反馈的反思，并在后续试验中使用它们。

sents.en: These approaches motivate a broader question: how can feedback produce improvements that remain useful beyond the current attempt and across related tasks?
sents.zh: 这些方法引出一个更广泛的问题：反馈如何能产生在当前尝试之外以及跨相关任务仍然有用的改进？

paragraphs.en: A central difficulty is deciding what should change. A failed manipulation may result from an incorrect object estimate, a poor prediction, an unsuitable plan, or an execution error. The same failure signal can therefore call for different updates across PAPAV. Revising the wrong component may leave the cause untouched or introduce new errors. The agent must connect the observed outcome to the assumptions and decisions that produced it, using evidence from execution.
paragraphs.zh: 一个核心难题是决定什么应当改变。 一次失败的操作可能源于错误的对象估计、糟糕的预测、不合适的计划或执行错误。 因此，同一个失败信号可能需要跨越 PAPAV 的不同环节进行不同的更新。 修改错误的组件可能使原因未被触及，或引入新的错误。 智能体必须利用执行过程中的证据，将观察到的结果与产生该结果的假设和决策联系起来。

sents.en: A central difficulty is deciding what should change.
sents.zh: 一个核心难题是决定什么应当改变。

sents.en: A failed manipulation may result from an incorrect object estimate, a poor prediction, an unsuitable plan, or an execution error.
sents.zh: 一次失败的操作可能源于错误的对象估计、糟糕的预测、不合适的计划或执行错误。

sents.en: The same failure signal can therefore call for different updates across PAPAV.
sents.zh: 因此，同一个失败信号可能需要跨越 PAPAV 的不同环节进行不同的更新。

sents.en: Revising the wrong component may leave the cause untouched or introduce new errors.
sents.zh: 修改错误的组件可能使原因未被触及，或引入新的错误。

sents.en: The agent must connect the observed outcome to the assumptions and decisions that produced it, using evidence from execution.
sents.zh: 智能体必须利用执行过程中的证据，将观察到的结果与产生该结果的假设和决策联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Core question: How can verification guide reliable improvement across the PAPAV loop?
paragraphs.zh: 核心问题：验证如何在整个 PAPAV 循环中引导可靠的改进？

paragraphs.en: An effective improvement loop must connect a judgment to a specific revision and test that revision through further interaction before retaining it for reuse. Feedback may correct a belief, update a prediction, revise a planning rule, or refine an execution strategy. Such changes can occur through memory and decision updates without changing model parameters. The difficult step is determining whether a revision addresses the cause of failure and when it remains applicable.
paragraphs.zh: 一个有效的改进循环必须将判断与具体的修订关联起来，并通过进一步的交互检验该修订，然后才将其保留以供复用。 反馈可以纠正一个信念、更新一个预测、修订一条规划规则，或改进一种执行策略。 这些变化可以通过记忆和决策的更新来实现，而无需改变模型参数。 困难的一步在于判断某项修订是否解决了失败的原因，以及它在何时仍然适用。

sents.en: An effective improvement loop must connect a judgment to a specific revision and test that revision through further interaction before retaining it for reuse.
sents.zh: 一个有效的改进循环必须将判断与具体的修订关联起来，并通过进一步的交互检验该修订，然后才将其保留以供复用。

sents.en: Feedback may correct a belief, update a prediction, revise a planning rule, or refine an execution strategy.
sents.zh: 反馈可以纠正一个信念、更新一个预测、修订一条规划规则，或改进一种执行策略。

sents.en: Such changes can occur through memory and decision updates without changing model parameters.
sents.zh: 这些变化可以通过记忆和决策的更新来实现，而无需改变模型参数。

sents.en: The difficult step is determining whether a revision addresses the cause of failure and when it remains applicable.
sents.zh: 困难的一步在于判断某项修订是否解决了失败的原因，以及它在何时仍然适用。

paragraphs.en: A successful retry alone does not establish lasting improvement. A correction may work in one scene but fail when objects, goals, or conditions change. Repeated feedback may also reinforce an incorrect explanation and spread its effects across the loop. Agents therefore need ways to retain useful lessons, limit their application to relevant situations, and reverse changes when new evidence contradicts them. The open challenge is to accumulate useful improvements while preventing errors in verification from accumulating through repeated updates and undermining previously acquired skills.
paragraphs.zh: 仅有一次成功的重试并不能证明持久的改进。 某种修正可能在一个场景中有效，但当对象、目标或条件发生变化时就会失效。 重复的反馈还可能强化错误的解释，并将其影响扩散到整个循环中。 因此，智能体需要一些方法来保留有用的经验教训，将其应用限制在相关情境中，并在新证据与之矛盾时撤销更改。 未解决的挑战在于如何累积有用的改进，同时防止验证中的错误通过反复更新而累积，进而损害先前获得的技能。

sents.en: A successful retry alone does not establish lasting improvement.
sents.zh: 仅有一次成功的重试并不能证明持久的改进。

sents.en: A correction may work in one scene but fail when objects, goals, or conditions change.
sents.zh: 某种修正可能在一个场景中有效，但当对象、目标或条件发生变化时就会失效。

sents.en: Repeated feedback may also reinforce an incorrect explanation and spread its effects across the loop.
sents.zh: 重复的反馈还可能强化错误的解释，并将其影响扩散到整个循环中。

sents.zh: 因此，智能体需要一些方法来保留有用的经验教训，将其应用限制在相关情境中，并在新证据与之矛盾时撤销更改。

sents.en: The open challenge is to accumulate useful improvements while preventing errors in verification from accumulating through repeated updates and undermining previously acquired skills.

paragraphs.en: This paper has asked what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use. To answer it, we introduced P A P A V , a unified capability-centric perspective that compares multimodal agents, robotic systems, and MMEAs through five functions in a shared task loop. Because each capability is defined by its contribution to the loop rather than by architecture, the digital–physical transition becomes directly comparable across research traditions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨了当一个多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，会发生哪些变化。 为回答这一问题，我们提出了 P A P A V，一个以能力为中心的统一视角，通过共享任务循环中的五项功能来比较多模态智能体、机器人系统和 MMEAs。 由于每项能力是根据其对循环的贡献而非架构来定义的，数字与物理之间的转变便可以在不同研究传统之间进行直接比较。

sents.en: This paper has asked what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use.
sents.zh: 本文探讨了当一个多模态智能体从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，会发生哪些变化。

sents.en: To answer it, we introduced P A P A V , a unified capability-centric perspective that compares multimodal agents, robotic systems, and MMEAs through five functions in a shared task loop.
sents.zh: 为回答这一问题，我们提出了 P A P A V，一个以能力为中心的统一视角，通过共享任务循环中的五项功能来比较多模态智能体、机器人系统和 MMEAs。

sents.en: Because each capability is defined by its contribution to the loop rather than by architecture, the digital–physical transition becomes directly comparable across research traditions.
sents.zh: 由于每项能力是根据其对循环的贡献而非架构来定义的，数字与物理之间的转变便可以在不同研究传统之间进行直接比较。

paragraphs.en: The comparison reveals a consistent shift. Embodiment preserves the task loop but subjects it to partial observability, limited simulatability, irreversibility, real-time coupling, and unverifiable outcomes. Choices that structured interfaces or system design settle in advance for computer-use agents remain open once the same agent uses a robot, so more decisions move into the interaction itself. Reliability therefore depends on how well an agent maintains its beliefs, qualifies its predictions, authorizes its commitments, keeps execution visible, and checks outcomes as physical consequences unfold.
paragraphs.zh: 对比揭示了一种一致的转变。 具身化保留了任务循环，但使其受到部分可观测性、有限可模拟性、不可逆性、实时耦合以及不可验证结果的制约。 对于使用计算机的智能体而言，那些由结构化界面或系统设计预先确定的选择，一旦同一个智能体使用机器人，就不再预先确定，因此更多决策转移到了交互本身。 因此，可靠性取决于智能体在物理后果展开的过程中，能否良好地维持其信念、限定其预测、授权其承诺、保持执行可见并核查结果。

sents.en: The comparison reveals a consistent shift.
sents.zh: 对比揭示了一种一致的转变。

sents.en: Embodiment preserves the task loop but subjects it to partial observability, limited simulatability, irreversibility, real-time coupling, and unverifiable outcomes.
sents.zh: 具身化保留了任务循环，但使其受到部分可观测性、有限可模拟性、不可逆性、实时耦合以及不可验证结果的制约。

sents.zh: 对于使用计算机的智能体而言，那些由结构化界面或系统设计预先确定的选择，一旦同一个智能体使用机器人，就不再预先确定，因此更多决策转移到了交互本身。

sents.en: Reliability therefore depends on how well an agent maintains its beliefs, qualifies its predictions, authorizes its commitments, keeps execution visible, and checks outcomes as physical consequences unfold.
sents.zh: 因此，可靠性取决于智能体在物理后果展开的过程中，能否良好地维持其信念、限定其预测、授权其承诺、保持执行可见并核查结果。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark analysis points to a broader lesson: end-to-end success is most informative when the underlying capabilities are also observable. Explicit evaluation currently concentrates on Act, while Anticipate and Verify remain largely hidden behind task success. Combining capability-level tests with end-to-end tasks would make failures easier to locate and reported progress easier to interpret. The open challenges we identify, from what an agent should remember to how it should act under uncertainty, follow from the same constraints and mark where the loop must be coordinated rather than merely assembled. We hope PAPAV offers a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and for measuring progress across the full interaction loop.
paragraphs.zh: 基准分析指出了一个更广泛的教训：只有当底层能力也可被观测时，端到端成功才最有信息量。 目前的显式评估集中于Act（行动）环节，而Anticipate（预判）和Verify（验证）环节在很大程度上仍隐藏于任务成功背后。 将能力层面的测试与端到端任务相结合，将使失败更容易定位，也使所报告的进展更容易解读。 我们识别出的开放性挑战——从智能体应该记住什么，到它如何在不确定性下行动——都源于同样的约束条件，并标示出交互循环中哪些环节需要协同设计而非简单拼装。 我们希望PAPAV能为设计可靠的物理智能体，以及在整个交互循环中衡量进展，提供一个共同的基础。
